We havent stalled the negotiations On the contrary we have given concessions that no gov in the world would give to a group who isnt even ready to recognize us as a gov Waheed Omer  the director general of the Afghan governments Office of Public and Strategic Affairs  said in  tweet yesterday
Earlier on  November Afghan presidential spokesman Sediq Sediqqi had also released a statement calling parts of the New York Times story unwarranted and baseless
President Ghani has done everything possible to initiate and drive the process and he will do everything within his constitutional powers to end the longtime suffering of the Afghan people he said
This comes amid conflicting reports of some progress being made in the intraAfghan talks in Qatar which have been held sporadically since  September
NATO chief reiterates need for ceasefire
In remarks made yesterday during the first session of the NATO foreign ministers meeting in Brussels NATO chief Jens Stoltenberg reiterated the need for a comprehensive ceasefire in Afghanistan Tolo News TV has reported

We call on Taliban to reduce violence but of course thats only the first step What we need to see is a lasting peace agreement And part of that has to be a ceasefire Stoltenberg said
The remarks come amid a marked upsurge in violence across Afghanistan including in Kabul where  according to a recent Tolo News TV report   mine blasts and rocket attacks took place between  and  November
The NATO chief also referred to the recent US decision to withdraw  troops from Afghanistan by midJanuary and warned against a hasty withdrawal
As we continue to assess the situation in Afghanistan it is clear that we will face a turning point early next year there is a price for staying longer But there is also a price for leaving too soon he said 
Concerns over safety of female judges
Hasina Safi  Afghanistans acting minister of women affairs  has stressed the need for providing safe opportunities for women to work as judges in insecure provinces the private Ariana News TV reported yesterday
All women need female judges in provinces to ensure justice Work opportunities should be provided to women in the provinces Safi said
According to the report security threats have been a major hindrance to the appointment of female judges in several provinces  especially in rural areas
Currently there are  female judges across Afghanistan the news channel reported
Most of them are in secure provinces If we have the trust of women we should have judges in all provinces Javid Rashidi the head of Afghanistans high court secretariat said
Security incidents
Afghan security forces have arrested some Taliban militants in Paghman district of Kabul province Tolo News TV reported yesterday
Citing a Defence Ministry source the news channel reported that the four detained militants were involved in IED blasts and targeted killings in Kabul
Meanwhile  civilians who were kidnapped by the Taliban in the central province of MaidanWardak have been freed Ariana News TV reported yesterday
Citing provincial officials the news channel reported that the civilians had been abducted from the provinces Jalrez district
The Taliban are yet to comment on the report

Text of report by DR Congos UNsponsored Radio Okapi on  December
Presenter A fresh attack attributed to Ugandan ADF Allied Democratic Forces has been reported on the Mbau Kamango road section Beni territory Nord Kivu Province in the east
A local civil society organisation says two civilians have gone missing A child was burned and two motorcycles were set ablaze by the assailants
Andre Kitenge reports
Kitenge Civil society in Kamango has expressed concern over the resurgence of attacks perpetrated by ADF rebel combatants on the Mbau Kamango road section
According to the organisations chairperson this latest ambush occurred at Kilometric Point  while the road was being used by both the military and civilians
Bernard Muhoze explains
Muhoze We denounce the ambush carried out at Kilometric Point  on the Mbau Kamango road section Some people were killed and two have gone missing Two motorcycles were also torched by the assailants
Kitenge This civil society activist calls on the FARDC DR Congo Armed Forces to reinforce their patrols on the road section that links Kamango to Watalinga chieftaincy for the protection of civilians and their property
However the FARDC did not confirm this latest attack attributed to the ADF rebels All our efforts to reach the spokesperson of the Sokola  operations sector in the Grand Nord region remained futile
This is the third such attack since last Friday  November on this same Mbau Kamango road section
Source Radio Okapi Goma in French  gmt  Dec

A round up of media stories about violence by terrorist groups and other terror related activity available to BBC Monitoring in the period  December 
AFRICA
Islamic State kidnaps Red Cross employee in Nigeria
In a brief statement on  December the Islamic State group IS said it kidnapped a Red Cross employee in Nigerias northeastern Borno State the previous day on the road linking the towns of Kareto and Gubio It gave no details about the purported abductees identity nor made a demand RocketChat messaging service in Arabic  Dec 
Boko Haram claims killing  Nigerian farmers in Borno
Boko Haram militants have claimed responsibility for killing dozens of rice farmers in Nigerias northeastern Borno state on  November
Abubakar Shekaus faction of Boko Haram Jamaatu Ahlussunnah Liddaawati Wal Jihad has released a new video in which it claims responsibility for killing  farmers in Zabarmari area of Borno State HumAngle a website associated with prominent Nigerian journalist Ahmad Salkida reported
In the video an unidentified Boko Haram commander accused the farmers of arresting one of its members and handing him to the Nigerian military HumAngle website in English  Dec  Telegram messaging service in Hausa  Dec 
Kenyan officer killed another missing after militant attack
A Kenyan police officer has been killed and another is missing after suspected alShabab militants attacked a police base in the northeast Garissa County The Star newspaper website reported According to the website police officers were at the Amuma base when gunmen fired at them for about  minutes before escaping The Star website in English  Dec 
Somali official accuses Kenyan army of withdrawing from south
Somalia has accused the Kenya Defence Forces KDF who are part of the African Union Mission in Somalia Amisom of withdrawing from strategic positions in southern Somalia without any consultation Minister of Information Osman Dubbe said this in a press conference broadcast live on the Facebook page of stateowned Somali National TV
He added that KDF and the Somali federal government do not have a good working relationship accusing KDF of withdrawing from their positions in Fahfahdhun and Busar The minister also accused Kenya of interference into Somalias Jubbaland state affairs and pressuring its leader Ahmed Mohamed Islam also known as Madobe
The accusations come days after the Somali federal government recalled its ambassador to Nairobi and asked Kenyas ambassador to Mogadishu to depart for consultations The Kenyan Ministry of Foreign Affairs denied reports that it is interfering in Somalias internal and political affairs FacebookSomali National TV in Somali  Dec 
Militants claim killing  soldiers in central Somalia
The alShabab group has said its militants killed  soldiers from the Galmudug regional forces in central Somalia on  November proalShabab Calamada website reported
The incident took place in the village of Baadweyn in Mudug region The militants reportedly seized six vehicles loaded with heavy machine guns including two antiaircraft guns and other military equipment
The Somali National Army radio website reported on  November that the government forces killed  alShabab fighters in the village Calamada in Somali  Dec 
AlShabab attacks African Union military bases in Somalia
According to the proAlShabab news website Somali Memo the groups militants have launched heavy attacks on foreign military bases in southern Somalia
They reportedly attacked several Amisom bases in the villages of Hosingow and Qoqan in Lower Juba and Arbaow in Lower Shabelle on  November No further details were provided Somali Memo website in Somali  Dec 
Somalia jihadists flaunt annual charity distribution
AlShabab has distributed religious aid zakat to thousands of people in the south of the country as part of an annual event according to an affiliated media outlet
In a series of photos the Shahada news agency reported that alShabab handed over donated cattle and livestock to thousands of poor families in Juba province The images show alShabab officials aid beneficiaries and dozens of animals including sheep and camels Telegram messaging service in Arabic  Nov 
Somali police foil bomb attack in Mogadishu
Somali police have shot dead a man who was allegedly planting a landmine in Horsed Ward Warta Nabada District Mogadishu Privatelyowned Somali Shabelle Media Network website quoted the district commissioner as saying that the police officers who were acting on a tipoff killed the man before he managed to bury the mine Shabelle Media Network website in Somali  Dec 
Southern African bloc to set up counterterrorism centre
The Southern African Development Community SADC is preparing to create a Regional Centre to Combat Terrorism privatelyowned Mozambican daily O Pais reported quoting SADC executive secretary Stergomena Lawrence The centre is expected to become operational by 
SADC is concerned that the terrorist attacks that affect Mozambique the Democratic Republic of Congo and recently Tanzania could spread to other countries in the region if they are not decisively tackled the report said O Pais in Portuguese  Nov 
Militants seize seven vessels kidnap  in northern Mozambique
According to the Mozambican newsletter Mediafax website on  December the militants active in Mocimboa da Praia district in northern Mozambiques Cabo Delgado province have seized at least seven boats and  people along the coast stretching between Mocimboa da Praia and Palma Districts The incidents took place in the last week of November near the Quifungue and Vamizi Islands
According to sources the boats were transporting food supplies from Pemba the capital of Cabo Delgado Province to Palma The insurgents intercepted the vessels near the coast of Mocimboa da Praia and seized the food supplies Mediafax website in Portuguese  Dec 
MIDDLE EAST
Coalition air strikes kill five IS militants in Iraqs Salahuddin
USled coalition air strikes have killed five Islamic State IS militants in Iraqs Salahuddin province north of Baghdad The international coalition air force carried out four air strikes on  December in coordination with the Joint Operations Command Iraqs cabinetaffiliated Security Media Cell said in a statement The statement added that the group had committed a terrorist act against citizens near alMashak village in Salahuddin Facebook in Arabic  Dec 
Iraqi forces reportedly kill six militants in Makhmour
The Iraqi CounterTerrorism Agency said that security forces killed six Islamic State IS group militants in an operation on  November in the disputed area of Makhmour in Ninawa province
The agency said that clashes erupted when the forces attacked the militants during a raid in which three were killed Three others attempted to flee but were killed by fighter jets belonging to the USled international coalition fighting IS the report added NRT TV in Kurdish  Nov 
SOUTH ASIA
Russian embassy staff injured as diplomatic vehicle blown up in Kabul
The Russian Foreign Ministry has said that several members of the Russian embassy in Kabul received light injuries when an improvised explosive device went off near their vehicle in the Afghan capital on  December
A statement published on the ministrys website said the explosion had occurred near the Russian embassy complex in Kabul The embassy staff received slight concussion said the ministrys spokesperson Maria Zakharova
According to preliminary reports the perpetrators of the attack planned to blow up another vehicle that was carrying Afghan soldiers and was moving ahead of the Russian embassys vehicle Zakharova said Ministry of Foreign Affairs website Moscow in Russian  Dec 
Afghan Taliban officials meet Russias Qatar envoy
The Talibans representatives in Doha met the Russian ambassador to Qatar to discuss bilateral issues and the intraAfghan peace negotiations the Pakistanbased Afghan Islamic Press news agency AIP news agency reported quoting a Taliban spokesman
Alongside with IntraAfghan negotiations the bilateral issues suitable with the region were discussed during the meeting he added No further details were provided Afghan Islamic Press news agency Peshawar in Pashto  Dec

Indonesian police say militant group used charity boxes to collect funds
Jemaah Islamiyah JI the group responsible for the  Bali bombing has deployed charity boxes at minimarkets in several regions in Indonesia to trick the unsuspecting shoppers into giving money to fund the groups activities Jakarta Globe newspaper reported quoting a police spokesman The police uncovered the funding operation after questioning  Jamaah Islamiyah members arrested in the past two months One of those arrested was Taufiq Bulaga aka Upik Lawanga an explosives expert the spokesman said Jakarta Globe website Jakarta in English  Dec

By BBC Monitoring
Iraqi security forces regained control of the town of Sinjar Nineveh Province on  December whilst the majority of the members of one of the main armed forces left according to the Iraqi Joint Operations Command
Command spokesperson Tahseen Khafaji was speaking to the Kurdistan Democratic Party KDPaffiliated Rudaw website on the same day about the departure of the Yazidi Kurdish Sinjar Resistance Units SRU also known as YBS
He said that  December marked the start of the practical implementation of a deal on Sinjar signed in October between the Iraqi and Kurdistan Regional Governments
He said that federal forces had spread throughout the town and that only Iraqi flags were flying
No other security forces are present in the district he said explaining that all political and party offices were closed including licenced offices
SRU members retreated when local police began to hand over the security dossier he said adding Only a few members of the forces are left and they too have started to retreat
The SRU is made up of local fighters It openly follows the political ideology of Turkeys Kurdish rebel group Kurdistan Workers Party PKK but denies having formal links to it
The mayor of Sinjar Mahma Khalil also told Rudaw that the SRU and other forces linked to the PKK had retreated from the centre of the town and that members of the federal police had taken up their positions
However he added that the SRU retreat was not comprehensive because although they had left their offices and bases fighters and members were still in Sinjar
Next stage
SRU member Heval Tekoshar told the NGOfunded Kirkuk Now website the previous day that his force was no longer present in Sinjar in accordance with the deal
He said the second phase of the deal involves discussing security checkpoints
In return for stationing our forces outside the town a number of our fighters are to be hired by the Popular Mobilisation Forces PMF he said
The report said that in addition to the federal police there were over  different fighters in Sinjar who are affiliated with the PMF SRU local police security Iraqi military and the Ezidikhan Protection Force which is affiliated with the Kurdistan Democratic Party KDP
The deal stipulates that local police and both national security and intelligence agencies will take over exclusive responsibility for security of the town in coordination with the security agencies of the Kurdistan Region Rudaw said citing the text of the deal
All other armed formations will be expelled to outside Sinjars town limits it added
The socalled Islamic State IS group took control of the Sinjar region from the KDP as part of its lightning assault on Iraq in  and which led to the PKK stepping in to support the locals
The PKK formally announced its withdrawal from the area in March  and an informal local Yazidi administration has been key to running the town and surrounding area ever since

Delegates at Tangier talks issue statement
Representatives of Libyas eastbased House of Representatives HoR and the rival westbased High Council of State HCS issued a statement at the end of a second round of talks in the Moroccan city of Tangier according to Libyan media outlets
Both sides discussed how to implement agreements reached by the two bodies in recent weeks on putting into force Article  of the Libyan Political Agreement LPA brokered by the UN in  which concerns Libyas sovereign institutions of the state AlWasat website quoted the statement as saying

A minigroup formed of members the two delegations will begin work in the next few days the statement said  
The two sides reportedly noted the necessity for Libyans to be in control of the political process and the need for the two sides to hold further direct meetings as an effective and transparent means to address issues obstructing the unification of institutions of the state and the ending of division and foreign interference 
The statement also pointed to the need for the state to assert its authority over all Libyan territories and for national reconciliation and transitional justice to take place  
Mitig ready to lead future unity cabinet
Vice President of the Presidency Council of the UNbrokered Government of National Accord GNA Ahmed Mitig Maiteeq has said he is ready to lead a future unity government if chosen by the Libyan people 
He was speaking in a virtual meeting with the Mediterranean Dialogues forum AlWasat website reported today 
The report quoted him as telling the forum that Libyan sovereignty comes first and adding that we have to be very clear on this matter we dont need foreign troops in Libya 
He praised the US role in the Libyan crisis as very positive noting that stability in North Africa and the Mediterranean is crucial to US security 
He ruled out the possibility of the new administration of US Presidentelect Joe Biden presenting an initiative on Libya early next year as it will have other priorities in the immediate period after it takes office in January according to the report 
Egypt Saudi opposed to foreign interference in Libya
Egypt and Saudi Arabia have reiterated their rejection of all forms of regional interference in the domestic affairs of Libya and other Arab countries and further denounced attempts to destabilise the region
Libyan media outlets reported a final communique issued last night by the EgyptianSaudi political consultation committee which convened in Riyadh and was led by both countries foreign ministers 
The statement rejected all forms of foreign interference in Libya and stressed the necessity of maintaining its stability and territorial integrity
Prominent doctor kidnapped in Tripoli
A veteran Libyan doctor has been reportedly kidnapped by unknown assailants in the capital Tripoli last evening 
Siddiq Ben Dala the head orthopedist in AlKhadra Hospital in the capital was abducted by armed men while he was driving back home AlWasat reported today 
It quoted eyewitnesses as saying that hooded men in two vehicles forced the doctor out of his car on the  June Road in Tripoli 
In a different account the website of the  TV channel said that the presumed kidnappers were four men in military uniform It quoted his son as saying that that his father escaped a failed kidnapping attempt while he was driving nearly two weeks ago
The GNAs interior ministry has not commented on the reported abduction while the spokesman for the chairman of the Presidency Council Ghalib alZaqlai reported it in a tweet according to  TV 
The two outlets highlighted the veteran doctors expertise and reputation citing an award he won from the Netherlands in  for treating a Dutch child who survived a plane crash near Tripoli airport in May the same year

The Turkish army is continuing to target the town of Ayn Issa also Ain Isa Raqqa Province and other areas in northern Syria including the strategic M motorway and villages near the town of Manbij Syrian Kurdish Ronahi TV reported on  December
Both Ayn Issa and Manbij lie on the M and fall under the control of the Kurdishled multiethnic Syrian Democratic Forces SDF

Islamic State group IS has claimed to have kidnapped a Red Cross employee in Nigerias northeastern Borno State on  December
In a brief claim on  December the group said it kidnapped the individual after setting up a fake checkpoint on the road linking the towns of Kareto and Gubio in Borno 
It gave no details about the purported abductees identity nor made a demand 
So far no mainstream media reports have been observed on this alleged incident
In August and September the group claimed attacks on Red Cross vehicles in the same area and using a similar tactic setting up fake checkpoints
That same month IS declared war on humanitarian agencies with focus on aid workers in Africa accusing them of implementing antiIslam agendas
This message was reiterated in October when the groups leadership incited Muslims in Africa to attack missionaries and aid agencies saying the latter offer aid stolen from you to hoodwink impoverished Muslims into converting to Christianity Full text of leadership message
IS released its latest claim through its channels on the messaging app RocketChat and Telegram 
The alleged attack comes a day after IS rival Boko Haram claimed responsibility for an attack on  November that killed dozens of farmers in Borno The two jihadist groups are active in northeast Nigeria and the Lake Chad region

Gaya labourer shot during extortion bid Link to Image Link to Story Patna Dec  IANS Around  unidentified men attacked a labourer involved in bridge construction in Bihars Gaya district The worker was shot at during a suspected extortion bid police said On Wednesday around  pm the victim Mohamad Saheb Momin sustained gunshot injuries in the head SHO of Fatehpur police station AH Ansari said
Momin is one of the labourers involved in construction of bridge on Dhandher river at Badaua Dehri village As labourers are staying in makeshift hutments at construction site they are attacked and kidnapped Momin met the same fate at gun point
As he tried to escape his attackers  of them tried to stop him while one shot at his head The incident took place after they had travelled some distance away from construction site
Momin apparently returned at the construction site despite a scull fracture Ansari said
The other labourers took him to ANMCH in Gaya He was later referred to PMCH in Patna in critical condition Ansari said
The eyewitness have claimed that the accused were wearing face mask looking for the contractor of the project They were demanding extortion money before allowing them to continue construction of the bridge
They also claimed that the attackers had demanded the extortion money from the contractor some  days ago and the shot at the worker and the attempt to kidnap him was to threaten him further
The matter is under investigation and we are trying too identify accused We have pressed for local intelligence to identify accused Ansari said
Sources have said that mafia dons of Gaya have been used to the practice of extorting protection money from every contractor before allowing them constructions of government or private projects
It was one of the poll issue in recently concluded Bihar Assembly election wherein NDA leaders pointed out organised extortion business during RJDs tenure flourished between  to 
Former Maharashtra CM Devendra Fadanvis had given  lakh tamanche remark to attack Tejashwi Yadav He said that if RJD would come to power Tejashwi would buy  lakh tamanche countrymade pistols to promote kidnapping and extortion business

Businessman Jorge Luis Brizuela Guevara appointed as close to Governor Carlos Joaqun Gonzlez suffered a gunshot attack yesterday in the Municipality of Benito Jurez in Quintana Roo Police reports indicate that the attack occurred during the early morning when subjects aboard two vans intercepted the car in which Brizuela Guevara was travelling known as El Venezolano on the CancunPuerto Morelos highway at the height of the Alfredo V Bonfil delegation The businessman himself released a video in which he complained that the attack occurred hours after filing a complaint with the State Attorney Generals Office FGE for threats against him Heres another bullet here we are all the people of the National Guard see me I denounce the corrupt the bandits and they dont listen bandits and without shame it is not possible that I filed the complaint today and they have given me precautionary measures and they have shot me he narrated According to local reports the businessman was undamaged because his Jeep pickup truck had armor allowing him to drive to the National Guard facility to guard himself Brizuela Guevara is Venezuelan a naturalized Mexican and has lived for more than  years in Quintana Roo where he has been accused of alleged extortion of local businessmen and politicians In March  he was in a ministerial investigation into the bombing on a ferry owned by former Governor Roberto Borges family although he was never proven the indictment or the case against him was never prosecuted

Gunfight between Maoists  security forces in Jkhand Link to Story Ranchi Dec  IANS A brief exchange of fire took place between a group of Maoists and security forces in the Palamu forested area of Jharkhand on Thursday that lead to the seizure of arms and ammunition from the insurgent group During the searches the CRPF said the security personnel recovered one AK  rifle three magazines some explosives one Bolt action rifle one mm pistol one country made weapon two wireless sets among other items from the battle ground
It was around  am when the gunfight broke out between the joint troops of  Battalion of Central Reserve Police Force CRPF Jharkhand Police and over a dozen Maoists in Salandir forest police said
The security personnel were on combing and search operation when the gun battle started said sources
The Maoist insurgency is an ongoing conflict in Jharkhand as well as other nine Maoistinfested states The insurgency started after formation of the CPIMaoists  a rebel group consisting of the PWG Peoples War Group and the MCC Maoist Communist Centre years ago

offices of zgr lke a Kurdish issuefocused newspaper published in the s A transport worker Ersin Yldz was killed and  others were wounded in the bombings on December   Journalists from Yeni Yaam goal This newspaper and its successors are continuing on their path Speaking after Trkeri Yeni Yaams newspapers editorinchief Ferhat elik said We were living in the days when dozens of our journalist and distributor friends most notably Ape Musa were murdered on the street CLICK   Years of Impunity in zgr lke Newspaper Bombing In the morning on December  we were in pain angry but not surprised We knew why they attacked us why those bombs exploded and we all said only one thing This newspaper will be published tomorrow And it did said elik HD CoChair Eren Keskin recalled that she was an attorney for the newspaper at the time and said the order for the attack was given by the armys Special Warfare Department while HDP stanbul Provincial Chair Elif Bulut said the parliament should investigate the bombings After the speeches carnations were laid in front of the newspapers office What happened On December   zgr lke newspapers technical headquarters in stanbuls Kadrga quarter central office in Caalolu quarter and office in the capital city of Ankara were bombed Transport worker Ersin Yldz  and  workers were wounded Following the incident the newspaper could only run with the help of other newspapers which let zgr lke staff work in their offices On December   the newspaper was published with four pages with the headline This Fire Could Burn You As Well About  days after the bombing zgr lke newspaper published an article about a topsecret document signed by thenPM Tansu iller The document cited the following with direct reference to the newspaper The activities selfproclaimed Caliphate and repeatedly declared defeat of the group ISIS cells still remain a major factor of instability in eastern Homs southern Raqqa in the countryside of Deir Ezzor and in the areas surrounding the US military garrison in alTanf ISIS cells regularly conduct attacks on civilian and military convoys moving between Homs and Deir Ezzor as well as on patrols and checkpoints of the Syrian Army in the aforementioned areas For example on November  ISIS ambushed a convoy of the alQatirji security group which guards government oil shipments in southern Raqqa The incident took place on the IthriyahRaqqa road  progovernment fighters were killed A day earlier on November  ISIS blew up an oil tanker guarded by alQatirji group with an improvised explosive device The alQatirji security group is affiliated with the alQatirji Company that imports oil from Syrias northeastern region controlled by the Kurdishled Syrian Democratic Forces to governmentcontrolled areas The company and its owners are on the US sanction list On November  ISIS cells stormed SAA military positions north of alSukhna and blew up a local gas pipeline The ISIS news agency Amaq claimed that  Syrian soldiers were killed in the attack ISIS also has a wide network of cells on the eastern bank of the Euphrates especially near the Omar oil fields area but it rarely conducted attacks there in recent months Local sources claim that ISIS members use the eastern bank of the Euphrates and border areas close to alTanf as rear bases for operations in central Syria The US military is present in northeastern Syria in much larger numbers than the US President Donald Trump used to think This was an open secret since the very start of the implementation of the Trumpdeclared troop withdrawal However on November  this fact was openly confirmed by James Jeffrey former Special Representative for Syria Engagement that said that US officials routinely lied to Trump over the number of troops deployed in Syria Currently US sources admit that up to  US troops remain in the conflict zone Together with military contractors and civilian specialists the real number is most likely closer to  The south of Syria remains one of the points of instability despite the Russiabacked reconciliation efforts there On November  a Tigr vehicle of the Russian Military Police was struck with an improvised explosive device on the road between alMusayfrah and alSahoah in the eastern countryside of Daraa The incident took place amid a new round of tensions between progovernment forces and former members of reconciled militant groups in the area The Syrian Army took control of the region and allowed the relatively moderate part of militant groups there to lay down arms as a part of a wide reconciliation agreement in  However since then the local reconciliation process has faced several obstacles including the resistance of a part of the local elites affiliated with militants Together with the close proximity to the Israelioccupied Golan Heights this turns the province into a permanent headache for the Damascus government The deescalation deal in Greater Idlib and the creation of the demilitarized zone in its south is once again stalled due to the Turkish unwillingness to break its ties with the alQaedalike terrorist groups like Hayat Tahrir alSham and the Turkistan Islamic Party because these groups are the core of the socalled Turkishbacked opposition This situation cannot be changed without another military operation of the Syrian Army or the Turkish will to finally start working against terrorists in Idlib The second scenario seems unlikely as it does not go in the interests of Ankara Nonetheless it seems that Moscow has not abandoned the idea to motivate Turkey for some constructive actions and during the last  months warplanes of the Russian Aerospace Forces conducted a large number of strikes on infrastructure and training camps of Turkishbacked terrorists At the same time Ankara has evacuated its observation posts in Maar Hattat Morek and Sher Mughar and started withdrawing forces from Qabtan alJabal and Sheikh Aqil Most of these positions were surrounded by the Syrian Army during the previous antiterrorist advances This move goes contrary to the loud claims of the Turkish leadership that it will withdraw zero posts even surrounded ones from Greater Idlib and instead of this will force the Syrian Army to withdraw to positions behind them This is a visual demonstration that the airstrike diplomacy efforts of the Russian side has a particular effect The war in Syria did not end and a comprehensive diplomatic solution has not yet been found due to the serious contradictions between the sides involved in the standoff Nonetheless the current format of the conflict allowed to put to an end the widescale military confrontations on the ground and moved the main agenda towards counterterrorism efforts economic and diplomatic New York AFPRegularly vilified for letting through too many hateful and racist messages Facebook is currently modifying its algorithms to more severely crack down on insults against minorities while stopping systematically withdrawing attacks against people of Caucasian origin men or AmericansThis development contrasts with the usual policy of the social network which generally does not wish to distinguish between genders or ethnicities But the group realized that hate speech targeting underrepresented groups can be the most dangerous a spokesperson for the social network told AFP on Thursday This is why we have modified our technology to focus on the words that users and experts tell us are the most serious such as those aimed at dehumanizing or despising a certain category of people the spokesperson said The group has also updated its practices to be more vigilant in the face of the implicit expression of hate speech such as the messages on the practice of blackface which consists for Caucasians to blacken their faces in order to make fun of black people or on stereotypes suggesting that Jews control the world Twitter which has its own policy of combating abusive and harmful content has embarked on a similar path by announcing Wednesday that it wants to ban any publication seeking to dehumanize according to racial ethnic or nationality criteria The micromessage platform for example plans to remove messages qualifying an ethnic racial or national group as rot parasites or cockroaches Men are fools Along with the development of automatic moderation systems that are more sensitive to speech against minorities Facebook has stopped using algorithms that proactively seek out certain attacks against Caucasians Americans and men like Americans are stupid or men are foolsBut the group can still remove them if they are reported to them Facebook just wants to rule out the idea that it more easily censors comments considered less harmful than racist attacks such as derogatory comments about men after a breakup According to the Washington Post which first reported on Facebooks policy developments on Thursday the social network wants to focus on content that is malicious against black people mestizos Muslims Jews and members of the LGBTQI communityMark Zuckerbergs company has for years mastered the automatic removal of certain content linked to pornography or terrorism for exampleThe spread of hate online is more complicated to manage as machines find it difficult to distinguish between news humor parodies rumors and insultsAs a result Facebook tends to more easily remove problematic content directed at people of Caucasian descent and report visible minority posts more often according to the Washington PostThe platform claims to have initiated the evolution of its moderation policy from  Such an initiative could be badly received by some of the users on the right in particular who already consider that social networks disadvantage conservative messagesBut like other major social networks Facebook is also regularly attacked by civil rights organizations who accuse it of not doing enough to fight against hate speech These grievances grew even more prominent this year after the death of African American George Floyd and the group faced a boycott this summer from several major groups  AFP

By Parwiz Arian
KABUL Hundreds of Taliban fighters on Wednesday launched a massive armed attack against three key districts of southern Kandahar province but their attack was pushed back by security forces and members of the group suffered heavy losses
The attacks were carried out against Zherai Dand and Marof districts of Kandahar Province on Wednesday in which hundreds of Taliban fighters were involved
During the counter attack  Taliban fighters were killed and  were wounded the Ministry of Defense said in a short statement
Several vehicles and motorcycles of the militants were also seized and a large amount of their weapons and ammunition were destroyed it said
The attack is considered the second largest armed attack by the group in the province in the past two months
Taliban attacks have increased in recent few months in the country particularly in the south
Due to such attacks  civilians have been killed and another  civilians were injured in the past one month according to the Ministry of Interior
Armed violence is on rise throughout the country in recent few months despite the fact that Afghan were expecting a ceasefire or at least a significant reduction in violence with the start of the intraAfghan talks
But during the past nearly three months of negotiations the government and Taliban representatives have only agreed on rules and procedures for the talks The two sides have now tasked working committees to prepare a draft of the agenda of the talks in which ceasefire is expected to be one of the top topics on the agenda

French govt to inspect nearly  mosques in coming days The French government will inspect nearly  mosques in the coming days as part of unprecedented measures against separatism In a Twitter post on Wednesday French Interior Minister Gerald Darmanin said state services would be inspecting  mosques adding that some of them could be closed as a result He said  mosques in the French capital Paris and  in the rest of the country would be checked and that  of them would be targeted with immediate actions at his request According to the French newspaper Le Figaro Darmanin has sent a circular to French governors on the inspection of the mosques The French government has adopted an antiIslam stance in recent months intensifying raids and pressure on mosques and Muslim associations In September two people died in a knife attack outside the former offices of French weekly magazine Charlie Hebdo On October  Samuel Paty a history teacher was allegedly beheaded outside his school in a suburb of Paris He raised controversy and provoked anger by showing blasphemous cartoons of Islams Prophet Muhammad PBUH to his students Paty was murdered by an yearold assailant identified as Chechen Abdullakh Anzorov who was shot dead by police soon after the killing Also on October  three people including a woman were killed following a knife attack which was considered a suspected terror attack at the Basilica of NotreDame in Nice Following those incidents French President Emmanuel Macron described Islam as a religion in crisis and declared war on Islamist separatism which he claimed was taking over Frances estimated sixmillionstrong Muslim population French Muslims criticized the remarks voicing concern that the speech would trigger hate crimes against them Macrons comments have angered not only the Muslim community in France but all Islamic nations leading to protests and calls for the boycott of French goods As part of a crackdown against Muslims French authorities have already ordered a sixmonth shutdown of the Grand Mosque of Pantin in a lowincome Paris suburb On November  Darmanin said  mosques had been closed in the last three years since  Macron took office AntiMuslim sentiments have been on the rise across Europe in recent years in the wake of terrorist attacks in the continent The attacks were carried out by the sympathizers of the terrorist group of Daesh or those of its members who had returned home following defeat in Iraq and Syria Muslim leaders in Europe and around the world have reiterated their unequivocal condemnation of the terrorist attacks

That Boko Haram is going after soft targets is a sign of weakness and desperation on their part especially after they have suffered huge setbacks in the hands of the military in recent times
Nigerias minister of information Lai Mohammed has insisted that the terror group Boko Haram are now resorting to attacks on soft targets because they have suffered defeat in the hands of the governments security forces
Mr Mohammed spoke at a meeting with the Newspaper Proprietors Association of Nigeria Thursday in Lagos
The truth which will rankle some people is that Boko Haram is today badly degraded and can only carry out cowardly attacks like the one against defenceless farmers over the weekend said Mr Mohammed
No nation no matter how powerful is immune to attacks on soft targets  happened despite the prowess of the most powerful army in the world Boko Harams only oxygen today is publicity Thats why they have rushed to release a video claiming responsibility for the killing of the farmers
Please note that that video was shared to instil fear in the civil populace and maintain relevance in the eyes of their sponsors There is no truth to the reason for their action
We therefore appeal to the general public to provide information about the insurgents to security forces to assist them in ending the war on terror
Mr Mohammed said the killing of defenceless farmers is an act of cowardice and savagery by a group of deranged terrorists
Unfortunate and saddening as it is the killing is not a true reflection of the progress being made by the military against Boko Haram That Boko Haram is going after soft targets is a sign of weakness and desperation on their part especially after they have suffered huge setbacks in the hands of the military in recent times
The modus operandi of a losing terror group is to go after soft targets in order to stay relevant
Thursdays meeting was a continuation of Mr Mohammeds weeklong engagement with Nigerian media professionals in Lagos On Tuesday the minister met with online publishers where he accused them of unfair reporting of the EndSARS protests
On Thursday he extended the accusation to the newspaper proprietors saying they allowed themselves to be misled by the social mediaDuring the EndSARS crisis almost all newspapers fell for the hoax that there was a massacre at the Lekki Toll Gate Mr Mohammed continued
Screaming headlines of  or more people shot dead at the Lekki Toll Gate made the front pages of newspapers without a shred of evidence It is baffling how newspapers which were supposed to have reporters and photographers on ground at the Lekki Toll Gate fell for such a hoax
Did they also rely on the fake news and disinformation that permeated social media Why shouldnt the newspapers have led the narrative with verifiable figures and wellgrounded sources
Had the papers done this perhaps the likes of CNN which were misled by social media would not have goofed so badly as they did We want to appeal to you to carry out a painstaking review of your coverage of the protest and its aftermath with a view to ensuring that such never happens again
In the aftermath of the EndSARS shootings at the Lekki Toll Gate several newspapers including PREMIUM TIMES and CNN have published investigative reports on what transpired on the day reports the Nigerian government continue to deny
Buharis resignation
Following the killing by Boko Haram of more than  farmers in Borno the Northern Elders Forum on Wednesday called for President Muhammadu Buharis resignation
At his meeting on Thursday Mr Mohammed described those making such calls as playing dirty politics with the issue of security and it is cheap and irresponsible
Mr President was elected in  for a fouryear term and reelected in  for another fouryear term No amount of hysterical calls for resignation will prevent him from serving out his term
Now lets put things in context Before Mr President assumed office Boko Haram could stroll into any city especially in the north to carry out deadly attacks Abuja the nations capital Kano Maiduguri Jos Damaturu etc were regularly targeted Motor parks churches mosques shopping complexes were not spared
Today that is a thing of the past Suicide bombers used to have a field day detonating their bombs and killing innocent people Today that is no longer the case Detonating Improvised Explosive Devices IED used to be a deadly tactic of Boko Haram Today that has changed Boko Haram used to occupy territory deposing and installing Emirs and collecting taxes Thats no longer the case
These changes are not mere happenstance They are part of the successes recorded by the military under this President Therefore calling on the President to resign every time there is a setback in the war on terror is a needless distraction and cheap politicking
About  people have been killed by Boko Haram between January  and October  according to the Nigeria Security Tracker published by the Council on Foreign Relations

The jihadistbacked Salvation Government in northern Syria has announced that its leader has been reelected for a new oneyear term
In a post via its channel on the messaging app Telegram on  December the Salvation Government shared the acceptance speech by Ali Keda
According to the governing authority and affiliated media outlets Keda was reappointed to his position after he won a poll at the Shura consultative Council an affiliated body that elects and approves the government
The Salvation Government was established in  and is widely believed to be a front for the jihadist group Hayat Tahrir alSham HTS which controls most of Syrias last rebelheld areas in the northwestern province of Idlib
Analysis Whos behind the Salvation Government running northern Syria
The US recently indicated that it still considers HTS to be a terrorist entity despite its protests this year claiming to be a moderate group
Details

According to Sham News Agency an outlet linked to the Salvation Government Ali Keda was elected after the Shura Council accepted the routine resignation of the government at the end of its oneyear term
Keda reportedly stood for reelection unopposed and won the votes of  out of  members of the Shura Council
Keda was elected as Prime Minister for the first time last year
He is now expected to choose ministers for his second term as leader of the Salvation Government
There have so far been three Salvation governments since  with each having a mandate of one year
The first leader of the HTSbacked administration was Muhammad alSheikh who started his oneyear term on  November  He was followed by Hilal who served from  December  Keda was selected as a new leader on  November 
Democratic process

Although the Salvation Government is not subject to popular elections officials and affiliated media have been keen to portray the democratic processes involved in selecting a leader for the governing body and the peaceful transition from one administration to the next
Sham News for instance has been providing rolling coverage of the political developments in the form of a series of photos and video reports
Some of the media output by Sham News shows closeup shots of ballot boxes and members of the Shura Council voting as well as officials counting votes
The outlet as well as Salvation Government channels on Telegram also carried statements by Keda and other senior officials at various stages of the transition to the fourth government in northern Syria
In his acceptance speech on his reelection as Prime Minister Keda said people in northern Syria are able to build a state of justice and freedom

At least seven maritime robbery incidents targeting small sailing and motor passenger vessels took place off the northern coast of Mozambique in the week to  December according to reports from individuals and media sources In all cases the vessels were stolen and those on board abducted Islamic Stateaffiliated insurgents were responsible for the hijackings according to the sources The first publicly reported incident occurred on the night of Monday  November when insurgents abducted two crew members from a small passengerboat sailing from Palma to Pemba both ports in Mozambiques northern province of Cabo Delgado The coastline between the two is under defacto control of the insurgents The Coastal and River Coastal Police of Cabo Delgado Province has reportedly been reducing the number of authorisations it provides to vessels transporting passengers to operate on this route as a result The Palma to Pemba maritime route is of growing importance to commerce in both cities due to disruption to land routes from regular smallarms ambushes of road cargo transport by insurgents 
Significance The series of maritime robberies has focused on small slowmoving vessels with limited numbers of passengers and crew Differing reports indicate the perpetrators used either canoes or small sailing and outboardmotor boats to apprehend their targets Based on the most recent attacks the insurgencys freedom to navigate along the northern Mozambican coastline is indicated but there is no indication of intent or capability to target larger cargo vessels However satellite imagery from Cabo Delgado provinces Mocimboa da Praia port which is under insurgents control indicates that the militants are likely to have access to faster and larger fishing vessels Affiliated insurgents in Tanzania have also been seen at sea carrying assault rifles and rocket propelled grenades The deployment of these assets would improve their capability to target maritime cargo vessels

On  November  Kataib Hizbullah KHs security spokesperson Abu Ali alAskari vowed KH would defend Sinjar together with the Ninewah plains Tel Afar and Kirkuk against the Kurdish Democratic Party KDP which is the main component of the Kurdistan Regional Government KRG This followed from the  October  agreement between the Baghdad government and the KRG over Sinjar which proIran Popular Mobilisation Units PMU like KH have opposed A number of mostly Yezidi militias dominate Sinjar especially the Kurdistan Workers Party PKK which has conducted a recent string of attacks against the KRG and Turkey
To counter the KRG and potentially Turkey Iranianbacked PMUs are likely to also support the PKK and its Sinjarbased subsidiary the SinjarShingal Resistance Units YBS increasing the probability and extent of armed conflict YBS and KH share the objective of keeping Sinjar within federal Iraq rather than under the KRG The BaghdadErbil agreement over Sinjar which prioritised Yezidi resettlement and reconstruction expressly called for both the PKK and Iranbacked PMUs to be removed giving both motivation to cooperate against the KRG which is backed by Turkey and the United States After the October Sinjar agreement a Yezidi delegation travelled to Baghdad to meet AbdulAziz alMuhammadawi Abu Fadak  the head of both KH and the PMU  and requested that the YBS continue operating in Sinjar That same month a Sinjar official alleged that the PMU was backing PKK activities in the area even inviting Irans Islamic Revolution Guards Corps IRGC to advise on setting up strategic sites for PKK use ProIran PMUs led by Kataeb Imam Ali entered Sinjar in  but in  they relegated control to their Yezidi components which currently include the Lalish Battalion Kojo Martyrs Brigade and the rd August Brigade The latter are in turn part of the proIran Badr Organisation and through these PMUs Iran also likely maintains support for and indirect influence over the PKKYBS The presence of Iranbacked PMUs in Sinjar helps contain Turkish Iraqi Sunni and KRG influence and subverts the prospect of a Turkishcontrolled Sunni buffer zone in Nineveh It also preserves access along the northern overland route of Irans Mediterranean Corridor
Military support for the PKKYBS by the PMUs or Iran would increase the likelihood of PKK attacks targeting the KRG especially the KDP andor Turkey Peshmerga and Turkish troops Turkish diplomatic facilities and commercial concerns KRGTurkey oil infrastructure and KDP party facilities On  October KRG security forces announced the arrest of  PKK fighters allegedly planning terrorist attacks in Erbil against the interests of an unspecified foreign country likely Turkey On  October the PKK attacked the Mardin segment of the KirkukCeyhan oil pipeline On  November a PKKlaid mine exploded at emanke in Dohuks Amedi district killing at least one KRG Peshmerga member PKK attacks against the KRG are likely in or near regions like Gare and Metina where the PKKs presence now runs up against fresh KRG Peshmerga deployments Such retaliatory attacks and others in major cities are unlikely to end if KRGTurkish military pressure on the PKKs Qandil Mountains base increases
Unless Turkey directly or in support of the KRG tries to seize control of Sinjar and the surrounding areas and expel the PMUs Iran is unlikely to directly arm or reinforce the PKK in attacks against Turkey and Turkish assets inside Iraq Despite an ongoing lowintensity insurgency by PJAK the PKKs Iranian franchise Iran has previously hosted and offered refuge to PKK militants Furthermore in militarily supporting Azerbaijan in the NagornoKarabakh conflict Turkey also reportedly deployed Syrian mercenaries close to Irans border raising Irans threat perceptions Substantive support for the PKK in attacks against Turkey or Turkish assets especially KRGTurkey oil pipelines and Turkish diplomatic and commercial interests at least beyond advice and intelligence would likely involve Iran and Iranianbacked militias supplying advanced weapon systems including rockets missiles and UAVs or even direct coinvolvement in the PKKs operations There is however so far no evidence of these indicators According to an IHS Markit source with contacts in the Turkish government the incoming Biden administration and Turkey are likely to focus on PKK bases in the Qandils likely to the exclusion of Sinjar 
Indicators of changing risk environment
Increasing risk
The KRG with or without direct Turkish intervention launches an offensive to take control of Sinjar more clearly incentivising the PKKYBS and proIran PMUs to join forces 
The PKKYBS is reported as employing qualitatively different and superior weaponry or tactics beyond their usual smallarms sniper attacks rocketpropelled grenades RPGs and improvised explosive devices IEDs which would indicate the likelihood of active military support from Iranbacked PMUs or Iran
Turkishbacked Syrian mercenaries remain in Azerbaijancontrolled areas of NagornoKarabakh and conduct attacks against Iranian territory or interests reinforcing Irans incentive to retaliate against Turkey by backing the PKK
The US withdraws its troops from Iraq and Syria incentivising Turkey to fill the vacuum in Sinjar Mosul and Nineveh province and triggering confrontations with Iranbacked PMU militias and the PKKYBS
Decreasing risk
In the event that TurkishTurkeyaligned forces seize Sinjar and Iranbacked PMU militias choose to withdraw rather than fight separate IranTurkey de facto spheres of influence emerge leaving the YBSPKK to their fate

Manchester Arena bombing inquiry Half of police officers required were on duty at time of atrocity Police were supposed to provide twice as many officers to patrol Manchester Arena as they did on the night of the terror attack at the venue an inquiry has heard British Transport Police who were responsible for the arena had also taken no written lessons from a training exercise that simulated an attack in the same spot targeted by suicide bomber Salman Abedi An inquiry into the bombing which claimed  lives and injured hundreds of people heard that senior officers had attended a tabletop training exercise in which a terrorist attack ended up in the same foyer where Abedi blew himself up  months later The exercise which simulated an attack on a Disney on Ice event had echoes of the audience profile for the Ariana Grande concert targeted in May  But the inquiry was told that BTP officers took no written learning from the event and could not remember whether they passed on any tips On the last day of evidence about security at the arena the inquiry was shown a tactical report by BTP that assessed the need for seven officers including a sergeant for busy events at the venue But on the night of the attack when  fans attended the concert there were only three officers PC Jessica Bullough who was on probation and two Police Community Support Officers PCSOs The officers were joined by another PCSO who was being mentored and was not allowed to patrol on his own Another constable PC Stephen Corke who was the most experienced did not turn up until after the explosion having claimed he had been diverted to check a vulnerable location Two officers took a twohour meal break including a fivemile drive for a kebab and at the time of the attack all four were standing together near the station entrance None were in the City Room foyer where they had been told to patrol and where Abedi had been hiding for an hour before setting off his bomb David BaMaung a protective security expert said the senior officer who failed to turn up should have notified his supervisors he was not going to be there in time and supervisors should have arranged a suitably experienced officer to oversee the staff Inspector Michelle Wedderburn who was responsible for staffing at most of the stations in Greater Manchester and the arena said she had not seen the tactical report before the attack and that the layout of the venue had changed since it was written The officer had attended the tabletop training exercise in which a terrorist attack began in Victoria Station on the night of a Disney on Ice event and ended up in the City Room foyer But the inspector told the inquiry she took away no written learning from Exercise Sherman The inquiry was shown a tactical report for what was then called the Phones U Arena written in June  three years before the attack When ticket sales were high the recommendation was for one sergeant four constables and two PCSOs A roster email suggested there should be five officers or PCSOs but on at least one other occasion in the days before the bombing the numbers fell well below that On the night of  May  when Abedi conducted hostile reconnaissance of a Take That concert there was only one officer and a PCSO and the officer had to ask for two special constables to be drafted in The inquiry continues

Metro Manila CNN Philippines December   Dozens of suspected Islamic militants attacked a police station and military unit in Datu Piang town in Maguindanao on Thursday night burning a police car before scampering away military officials confirmed to CNN Philippines
Lt Col Anhouvic Atilano spokesperson of the Armys th Infantry Battalion recounted that some  suspected members of local terror group Bangsamoro Islamic Freedom Fighters and Dawlah Islamiyah conducted two simultaneous strikes around  pm
Atilano said the group created the commotion in the military detachment to prevent troops from responding to the attack and harassment in the police station in Poblacion Despite the diversion troops arrived at the police station engaging the militants and forcing them to scurry away On their way out the gunmen burned a police patrol car outside the municipal police station
Based doon sa naengage natin tropa na nasa detachment patrol base yung pumasok dito sa Poblacion ay more or less  Ang nagharrass naman sa headquarters ng Charlie Company natin more or less  So more or less mga  sila Atilano told CNN Philippines on Friday
Translation We engaged with more or less  people in the detachment and patrol base More or less  people harassed the Charlie Company headquarters So a total of  more or less
Atilano said that based on their initial investigation the BIFF and Dawlah Islamiyah members were targeting the chief of police But he said they will continue to look into the angle of a terrorist attack
The military officer said there were no casualties recorded He said the only damaged property was the police patrol car denying earlier reports a nearby church and school were burned down
He said they are tracking down the two main leaders of the armed men He assured authorities are on top of the situation saying they have increased the number of security forces to guard the area
Nais po nating iparating sa lahat ng mamamayan dito sa Datu Piang at sa karatig na mga munisipyo ng Maguindanao na ang Datu Piang po ay safe na he said
Translation We want to tell the residents in Datu Piang and nearby areas that its already safe
The Armed Forces of the Philippines and the Philippine National Police are conducting a joint investigation into the isolated incident the Western Mindanao Command said
Another Marawi siege
The attack in Datu Piang was nothing like the  siege in Marawi that killed a total of  militants soldiers and civilians in its wake AFP chief Gen Gilbert Gapay said
Even another Marawi is highly improbable at this point in time because they have already learned their lessons of Marawi and we can consider what happened in Datu Piang as an isolated case he told a media briefing Its really far from another Marawi incident
ISISinspired fighters from the Maute and Abu Sayyaf groups laid siege to Marawi on May   The battle between government forces and the local terror groups which lasted for five months resulted in mass displacement of residents and left the Islamic city in ruins

CSIS warns about conspiracy theories linking COVID to G technology Conspiracy theories linking G technology to COVID have become so pervasive that Canadas intelligence service is warning of possible extremist attacks on sites associated with the wireless network A confidential Canadian Security Intelligence Service report obtained by Global News anticipates that ideologically motivated violent IMV extremists may target G sites As companies begin G infrastructure construction in earnest extremists from across the IMV extremist landscape could engage in acts of arson and vandalism against that infrastructure the report said The report was among a cache of documents on the national security implications of COVID released to Global News under the Access to Information Act The documents show CSIS has been monitoring the pandemic for the Canadian government and its international partners focusing particularly on COVID disinformation spread by authoritarian states and extremist groups Given the extraordinary effect the COVID pandemic has created on the lives of individuals across the world CSIS is mindful that certain threat actors across multiple threat landscapes may seek to take advantage to advance their own interests CSIS spokesperson John Townsend said when asked about the documents COVID conspiracy theories have been circulated by governments trying to deflect blame for their failures and extremist groups trying to capitalize on public anxiety Among the more popular is that the coronavirus is caused by radiation poisoning from G technology Another claims governments are using lockdowns to build G infrastructure Perhaps the most elaborate asserts that G was designed by governments to depopulate the world and is part of a broader conspiracy theory called Agenda  that imagines the United Nations is trying to establish a new world order None have any scientific validity but white supremacists neoNazis and anarchists have all adopted COVID conspiracy theories to varying degrees while the antivaxxer movement has promoted the notion that G is responsible for spreading COVID Other conspiracy theories targeting COVIDG have emerged from various online anticapitalist antitechnology and environmental groupscommunities according to the CSIS report A not insignificant minority of Canadians falsely believe in a connection between the COVID pandemic and G technology according to a CSIS intelligence assessment dated May   In Canada physical opposition to G infrastructure is significantly less when compared to recent actions in the UK and Europe the report said But it said Canadianbased online communities were promoting the G conspiracy and that farright extremist groups were trying to capitalize on G hysteria The report noted that a cellphone tower in Laval Que was the target of a significant attack in April that caused  million in damage Another halfdozen towers were torched north of Montreal in early May Two people were charged None of the towers were associated with G networks A May  post on a QAnon Quebec Facebook page showed a cell tower burning in Italy and generated comments such as burn them all and instructions on how to do so according to the Middle East Media Research Institute CSIS is aware of how conspiracy theories have the potential to inspire individuals to take violent extremist action Townsend said A terrorism expert said the G conspiracy theories that were popular early in the pandemic had declined as new ones had emerged within the antimask and antilockdown movements As the vaccine rollout begins I think we should be prepared for a whole new set of conspiracies related to the vaccine as well said Amarnath Amarasingam a Queens University professor who specializes in extremist groups Research has found the more people believe in conspiracy theories the more realworld impact it has in their lives he said adding they were less likely to vaccinate their children or believe experts So while it would be great to ignore these fringe ideas they sadly often have outsized impact Amarasingam said The recent wave of conspiracy theories has also been a driver of violence he said We never really saw that with past conspiracies related to  or the moon landing or the JFK assassination Both G and G technology were also the subject of conspiracy theories that linked them to cancer The G conspiracy theory appears to have originated with an article in January  with an article in an obscure Belgian newspaper that was soon deleted Its impact was felt particularly in the United Kingdom where there have been dozens of attacks on telecommunications masts Conspiracy theories linking COVID and G have become extremely popular online and within multiple portions of the IMV landscape CSIS wrote Within this milieu are individuals who engage in encourage or support attacks on G infrastructure and harass telecom workers CSIS wrote in the report Conspiracy Theories COVID and Threats to G Infrastructure Islamic State Fighters First Claimed Attack in Tanzania Strategic Calculations and Political Context On October  Islamic State IS fighters in Mozambique staged their first claimed attack into southern Tanzania killing at least  people in Kitaya Mtwara Province The fighters also burned down houses destroyed an armored vehicle and stole money and military equipment Mtwara borders Palma district in the Mozambican Province of Cabo Delgado which is the base of the group known as Ahlu alSunna Wal Jamaa or alShabaab The Youth locally but officially as Islamic State in Central Africa Province ISCAP  The Citizen  October  Club of Mozambique  October  Some ISCAP members were initially followers of Kenyan Islamist ideologue the late Aboud Rogo and resettled in northern Mozambique after Rogo was killed extrajudicially in a driveby shooting in Mombasa in  ISCAP also has religious commercial and training ties with jihadist networks in Kenya Tanzania and elsewhere in East Africa  Club of Mozambique  June   The group however only started carrying out attacks in northern Mozambique in  and has since killed an estimated  civilians Like other Islamist militants in Africa ISCAP demands that governments rule by sharia Islamic Law  The Africa Report  July  Since IS territorial caliphate in Syria and Iraq began collapsing its leadership has been keen to expand in Africa In August  IS former caliph Abubakar alBaghdadi indicated plans to create a Central Africa province  wilaya   TwittercomSimNasr  August   Less than one year later in April  IS claimed an attack in Beni Democratic Peoples Republic of Congo DRC killing two soldiers and one civilian which heralded the launch of ISCAP as a formal IS province  The East African  April   By that time attacks were also intensifying in northern Mozambique whose fighters along with the DRC insurgents soon became subsumed under ISCAP Islamic States Ambitions in Tanzania ISCAPs attack in southern Tanzania underlines IS ambition to expand its territory in Africa While ISCAP has gained some success around Beni in DRC and Cabo Delgado in Mozambique it has been slower to gain traction in Tanzania and Kenya where in contrast alQaeda had success historically In  Tanzanian officials blamed an unidentified terrorist network for the killing of eight policemen in Kabiti district Although the attackers had disappeared with the policemens guns officials said the attackers were linked to another attack in Dar es Salaam in which the gunmen stormed Sitakishari police station and stole  guns Four policemen were killed in that attack The police later said they had killed four suspects in connection with the murders of the policemen in Kabiti  The East African  April   African News  April  Therefore with its first official attack claim in Tanzania IS and ISCAP have scored a victory Moreover Tanzanias police inspector general estimated at least  militants took part in the attack before they retreated to Mozambique This attests to large numbers of fighters involved in the operation  The Citizen  October  The jihadists gained access to Kitaya village after entering into Tanzania by sea and moving up Ruvuma River which forms the border between Mozambique and Tanzania  Club of Mozambique October  Photographs of the attack that IS released on its social media platforms and that were released outside official IS media channels further showed an attacker decapitating a man and throwing his head on the road as well as weapons and ammunition that the fighters pilfered  Club of Mozambique  October  In a video the attackers were also heard speaking in Swahili which is widely spoken in East Africa They were also heard speaking Makua which is a Bantu dialect in southern Tanzania and Mozambique and Mwani which is a Swahili dialect spoken in Cabo Delgado This language diversity indicates northern Mozambique is a meeting point for East African jihadists from the Swahili Coast and perhaps elsewhere in East Africa  Club of Mozambique  October  Nearly a month after the October attack Tanzanian police announced the arrest of an unspecified number of Tanzanians suspected to be travelling to join ISCAP in Mozambique The alleged recruits were from Kigoma in the west Mwanza in the north and other parts of Tanzania After these arrests the police said they had learned that many Tanzanians were involved in the attack in Mtwara and local villagers had helped ISCAP identify targets including houses to set ablaze  Club of Mozambique  November  Tanzanian Leaderships Responses ISCAPs Mtwara attack occurred on the eve of Tanzanias national elections but information gathered from the videos indicates that the militants motivations were unrelated to the polls According to utterances heard during the attack the motive was to kill what they the militants considered infidels and spread ISCAPs teachings in Tanzania  Club of Mozambique  October  Incumbent president John Pombe Magufuli whose party is Chama Cha Mapindunzi CCM won the elections by receiving  percent of the vote However his main challenger Tundu Lissu of the Party for Democracy and Development CHADEMA said the elections were riddled with irregularities such as ballotstuffing  Capital FM  October  Ahead of Magufulis inauguration key opposition figures were arrested and later released with no charges A senior police officer in Dar es Salaam later said they would be charged with acts of terrorism and endangering national security  The Africa Report  November  These allegations were however not linked to the threat posed by ISCAP or any known violent threat In the past Tanzania has frequently expressed its willingness to support global counterterrorism efforts  Daily News  March  Tanzania is also aware of the threats posed by ISCAP In May the government sent troops to the border with Mozambique to bolster security after ISCAP escalated attacks on security forces and civilians in nearby Cabo Delgado  The Citizen  May  In August Tanzania also carried out an operation on the border with Mozambique to flush out jihadists who were believed to be hiding in the forests there  Club of Mozambique  August  Conclusion The claimed attack in Tanzania by ISCAP represents a wellplanned move that fits into IS and ISCAPs ambitious designs for the future Congo and Mozambique are now part of IS caliphate Security agencies in Kenya Uganda and especially Tanzania must continue to be on alert given the speed at which ISCAP is gaining ground

Afghan Activists Cautiously Optimistic About New Protection for Rights DefendersBy Roshan NoorzaiDecember    PMAfghan human rights monitors are sounding the alarm over a spike in attacks against them by unknown assailants as they cautiously welcome the formation of a new government body to protect rights activistsIn a presidential decree Tuesday the government in Kabul announced the Joint Commission for the Protection of Human Rights Defenders to address human rights issues in Afghanistan and establish a protection mechanism for rights advocates The commission is led by Vice President Sarwar Danish with the minister of interior and the head of the National Directorate of Security NDS as its membersThe establishment of such a commission was needed said Lal Gul chairman of the Afghanistan Human Rights OrganizationGul whose Kabul office was attacked in  and  by unidentified armed men expressed frustration at the way the government has handled cases of targeted killings against activists He said that security forces have largely failed to provide satisfactory answers to the families of victimsIt is difficult to talk about the effectiveness of forming such a commission Let us see what measures and actions it will take he told VOA from KabulEarlier this year  human rights organizations in Afghanistan called on the government to establish such a body to address an uptick in violence against rights activists The organizations cited harassment threats and violence against rights activists adding that the attacks were not effectively investigated and suspected perpetrators have not been brought to justiceHeavy toll in The UN Assistance Mission in Afghanistan UNAMA reported in October that  civilians were killed and  injured in targeted killings in the first nine months of  a  increase compared with the same period in  With  total civilian deaths from violence it said targeted killing was the third main cause of civilian casualties after ground engagement and improvised explosive devicesAccording to Zabihullah Farhang a spokesperson for Afghanistans Independent Human Rights Commission AIHRC a string of assassinations in recent months have targeted women working outside their homes rights activists tribal and community leaders religious figures and journalistsHe said the violence is one of the bloodiest tactics used by militants to intimidate those promoting human rights and civil society in the countryThe watchdog Amnesty International said in a statement Thursday that the establishment of the new government commission was a major step to address the risks rights defenders are facingWith violence escalating across the country attacks on human rights defenders on the rise and huge uncertainty around the outcome of the peace talks this commitment could not come at a more important time said Samira Hamidi Amnesty Internationals Afghanistan campaignerHamidi asked the government of Ashraf Ghani to provide full support to the body to ensure that this isnt just an empty promiseAfghan officials have repeatedly blamed the Taliban and its Haqqani Network affiliate for the recent assassination attempts saying the group uses violence to pressure the governmentThey are the major terrorist groups These attacks are beyond the capabilities of other groups Siddeq Siddiqqui a spokesperson for the Afghan government told VOASome skepticsHowever some activists remain suspicious of the government position saying the security authorities are not transparent in their investigation into most of the casesOne of the skeptics Mudasar Dawat told VOA that security officials have given his family contradicting accounts of the November  assassination of his brother Mohammad Ilyas Dayee  who was a journalist with Radio Free EuropeRadio LibertyThe government officials tell us that the case is under investigation and that they have arrested some and suspect a few others But they have not provided us further information Dawat said His brother was killed when a magnetic bomb ripped through his carHis only crime was giving voice to the people in Helmand Dawat saidNo group has taken responsibility for the killing Human Rights Watch in a statement November  said Dayee had told the organization he received death threats warning him not to report about Taliban military operationsShukria Barakzai a former member of the lower house of Afghan parliament expressed similar concerns about the authorities handling the investigation of the  failed suicide bombing attack against herUnfortunately the Afghan government has told me different stories First they told me that the Taliban were behind the attack then they told me that it was Haqqani Network I still do not know who was behind the attack Barakzai saidSome Afghan experts say the government will likely have to provide security for outspoken rights activists who are vulnerable to militant attacks in the coming monthsSayed Khalid Sadat a law professor at Salam University in Kabul told VOA the newly formed government commission could help provide that security if the government gives it executive powersThe commission should act as a coordinating body between state security agencies and it should have executive power to address the threats that the human rights activists are facing Sadat said
