Afghan election watchdog chief shot dead in Kabul
Yousuf Rashid the head of the Afghan electoral watchdog Free and Fair Election Forum of Afghanistan FEFA died after being wounded in an armed attack in Kabul on the morning of  December the private Tolo News TV reported The FEFA chief executive was attacked by unidentified gunmen in Kabuls Police District  No group or individual has claimed responsibility for the attack yet Tolo News Kabul in Dari  Dec 
Islamic State claims responsibility for car bomb attack in Afghan capital
The Islamic State group IS claimed responsibility for a car bomb attack on  December in the Afghan capital Kabul that killed at least five people including prison employees and doctors The jihadist group made the claim in a short statement the same day via its channels on the messaging platform RocketChat Mainstream media reported that five people including prison officials and doctors were killed when a sticky bomb attached to their car detonated The Taliban denied involvement in the incident RocketChat messaging service in Arabic  Dec 
Car bombing killed three injured  in north Afghanistan
At least three soldiers have been killed and  others including five civilians were injured in a car bomb attack on a security post in Dawlatabad district of northern Faryab province the Pakistanbased private Afghan Islamic Press AIP reported The incident took place on the night of  December  Afghan Islamic Press news agency in Pashto  Dec 
Three civilians one soldier killed in east Afghan blast
At least four people have been killed and four others injured in a roadside mine explosion in Saberi district of Afghanistans eastern Khost province Afghan Islamic Press AIP news agency reported The explosion targeted an Afghan National Armys ANA vehicle on  December Afghan Islamic Press news agency in Pashto  Dec 
At least  suspected militants killed in Pakistans Balochistan
At least  suspected terrorists have been killed in a gun battle with security forces during an intelligencebased operation in the Awaran area of Balochistan Pakistani daily Dawn reported One Pakistani soldier was also killed during the incident on  December in Gwargo Awaran A cache of arms and ammunition was recovered from the militants hideout Dawn website Karachi in English  Dec 
MIDDLE EAST
Three IS commanders held in Syrian prison moved to Iraq
Three commanders of the Islamic State group IS have been moved from a prison controlled by the Kurdishled Syrian forces in the northern Hasaka Province to Iraq by the USled international coalition proopposition Step News website  reported on  December The report named the three men all Iraqi nationals as Mohsin Hamad who was responsible for weapon supplies Hassun alKazem who was in charge of training and the third man Mohamed alNijm made boobytraps for the militant group STEP news agency in Arabic  Dec 
Car bomb kills local official in Kurdishheld area in Syria
A local official was killed when a bomb planted in his car exploded outside his office in the village of alKubar in Syrias eastern Deir alZour Province on  December Syrian Kurdish Hawar News Agency ANHA reported The report said that the victim was a member of the local civilian council affiliated to the selfdeclared multiethnic Autonomous Administration of North and East Syria linked to the Kurdishled Syrian Democratic Forces SDF Hawar News Agency website in Kurmanji Kurdish  Dec 
AFRICA
US aircraft carrier arrives in Somalia coast to relocate troops
The US aircraft carrier USS Hershel Woody Williams has arrived off the coast of Somalia to relocate US troops based in Somalia according to the US Africa Command Africom The vessel is carrying members of the navy as well as helicopters and cargo aircraft which will take part in an operation to withdraw US troops from Somalia and protect them from any security threats The US air force has already vacated bases in several Somali towns Outgoing US President Donald Trump has ordered the withdrawal of nearly  American troops from Somalia by early  Caasimada Online in Somali  Dec 
Turkey reportedly sends spy drones to Somalias Gedo Region
Turkey has reportedly dispatched an aircraft and surveillance drones to support the Somalia federal government forces in the southwest Gedo Region Somali website Garowe Online reported The report added that the Somali federal government deployed hundreds of Turkishtrained Gorgor forces in Dolow Region and Turkey was providing logistical support to the troops
The development follows media reports that Turkey would take over the training of Somalias Danab special forces and also carry out air strikes against alShabab and Islamic State militants after the US forces withdraw from Somalia Turkey has built its largest overseas military base Turksom in the Somali capital Mogadishu in  and provides training and logistical support to the Somali national army and police Garowe Online in English  Dec 
AlShabab attacks Kenyan army positions in southern Somalia
The proAlShabab website Calamada reported that the groups militants attacked Kenyan army troops in villages in the southern Lower Juba region on  December They attacked the Kenyan soldiers who are part of the African Union peacekeepers in the country in the villages of Qoqani Abdala Birole and YontoyThere were reports of casualties in the attack on Abdala Birole Calamada website in Somali  Dec 
Somalias alShabab sentences man to death
An alShabab court in Lower Shabelle has sentenced a man to death for murder in Kunturwarey District proAlShabab news website Somali Memo reported The killer identified as Abdullahi Abdi Osman  was executed on  December by an alShabab firing squad at a public square in the district over the killing of Maalim Aweys Arbow Mohamed The court also issued a verdict for an yearold man to be fined and have his right arm amputated after he confessed to stealing from a shop The amputation took place at a public square in Aden Yabal District Somali Memo website in Somali  Dec 
Nigerian intelligence agency warns of terror threat during festive season
A Nigerian intelligence agency has warned of possible terror attack during the festive season Premium Times website reported quoting the countrys Department of State Services DSS DSS asked citizens to be extra vigilant and report suspicious activities to security authorities The warning follows two high profile kidnapping incidents in Katsina and Edo states in northwest Nigeria Premium Times Abuja  Dec 
JIHADIST GROUPS
ProIslamic State media incite attacks over holiday season
ProIslamic State group IS media groups have released posters that incite violence in western countries during Christmas  an annual tradition for such outfits The threatening images were shared in recent days by proIS channels on the messaging platform RocketChat
The latest batch posters followed the cliches set in previous years such as images of Father Christmas in the crosshairs of a snipers rifle AlDawat media group for example shared images of Father Christmas being detained by militants against the backdrop of a wartorn Paris The group also shared an image of Christmas presents filled with explosives Meanwhile the Wathib media group shared a poster of a masked militant lying in wait to ambush Father Christmas It is unclear if the posters are new or recycled from previous years as none of the ones observed had references to the Covid pandemic RocketChat messaging service in Arabic  Dec 
Analysis Islamic States subSaharan strongholds expand in 
The Islamic State group IS continued to grow its bases in subSaharan Africa during  with some of its branches there claiming significantly more attacks and casualties than the previous year At the same time the group ramped up its propaganda aimed at the continent promoting operations and declaring war on local jihadist rivals Christians and aid agencies
According to data collected by BBC Monitoring from ISs official media output attack claims have risen by a third in the Lake Chad Basin area covering northeastern Nigeria Chad and eastern Niger
Claims from ISs selfproclaimed Central Africa Province based in geographically separated northern Mozambique and eastern DR Congo have more than tripled This branch also extended its reach into Tanzania in 
Meanwhile the groups Sahel affiliate which is based in Mali Burkina Faso and western Niger has seen a drop in claims against government and foreign forces as it became engaged in a new conflict with the local alQaeda affiliate Jamaat Nusrat alIslam walMuslimin JNIM Read more here BBC Monitoring  Dec 
Source BBC Monitoring  Dec

Text of editorial titled Explosions and killings are used to pave the way for a negative change in Pashto language by private Maseer newspaper on  December
Bomb explosions and attacks in several provinces including the capital Kabul and Kandahar province yesterday caused civilian casualties again
Sticky bombs have become a daily occurrence in Kabul Authorities hold the Taliban responsible but the Taliban not only deny involvement in many of these incidents but also accuse the government
Killing and bomb explosions take place every day but the perpetrators remain unknown and nobody takes responsibility for the attacks There are killings but the killers are unknown and are not showing themselves
Regardless of who is to blame the people are being killed every day something that must be stopped

By BBC Monitoring

A prominent supporter of Islamic State group IS has promoted a new disseminator of the groups propaganda and shared links to its accounts on Twitter and Facebook
On  December Abu Nusaybah posted via his account on the messaging app Telegram a post advertising the outfit named Wikalat Bashair alKhilafah it calls itself in English Glad Tidings Of The Caliphate
Remarkably the accounts of Bashair alKhilafah which became active on Facebook and Twitter on  and  December respectively are still online despite the usually swift removal of jihadist accounts by the two popular social media platforms
Their resilience appears to be due in part to the way the text of IS claims of attack is displayed combining the use Arabic vocalisation and separating some individual words with spaces presumably in order to fool the algorithms used by Twitter and Facebook to detect ISrelated propaganda
So far the new outfit has been observed to be promoted by only a small number of IS supporters on Telegram
Bashair alKhilafah
The new media groups name in Arabic translates as caliphate glad tidings agency
It describes itself as a support agency focused on distributing material issued officially by Islamic State
The new outfit joins two other IS existing distributors of IS material The official Nashir News Agency which currently operates mostly privately via Telegram and Nashir alDawlah alIslamiyah which recently rebranded as Caliphate News Agency and operates two channels on the proIS TechHaven server hosted by the decentralised platform RocketChat
In the post shared by Abu Nusaybah Wikalat Bashair alKhilafah also says that it has pledged allegiance to IS leader Abu Ibrahim alQurashi
In addition to its accounts on Facebook and Twitter the Telegram post provided Telegram accounts TWASOLWB and wpppp as a contact to request links to Bashair alKhilafahs accounts presumably on Telegram
IS claims of attack are currently first posted on Bashair alKhilahs Twitter account kingnoorm before they appear on its Facebook page
Bashair alKhilahs Twitter account became active on  December When BBC Monitoring accessed it on  December it had only five followers and featured  tweets
The outfits Facebook page which describes itself as a personal blog became active on  December and currently has  followers and  likes
Resilience tactics
Bashair alKhilafah is using various tactics to hide the nature of the material it is promoting on Twitter and Facebook ie IS propaganda which consists mainly of claims of attack by the jihadist groups militants in countries where it operates
For example so far on both Twitter and Facebook the new outfit has mostly avoided sharing IS claims of attack in image format as they are being shared by Nashir News Agency and Caliphate News Agency The only exception was on  December when Bashair alKhilafah shared an image of a claim of attack in Iraqs Diyala province issued by ISs news outlet Amaq
In addition some Arabic words that could be associated with IS such as wilayah province and alKahyr ISs name for the Syrian province of Deir alZour include a space
Some Arabic words in the text of a claim also feature additional characters serving as vowels IS statements are released without such characters as is the case for most Arabic printed text
The two features appear to be aimed at thwarting attempts by Twitter and Facebook to detect and remove ISlinked material
IS supporters and jihadists in general have long used similar tactics to avoid being detected and suspended by social media platforms
For example currently on Telegram many jihadist accounts have resorted to avoiding using full words as their user names and instead use a variety of ways to display them such as mixing Arabic with nonArabic characters
IS supporters often lecture each other about the importance of being active on Twitter and Facebook to reach a global audience as opposed to being confined to apps with limited reach such as Telegram and Hoop which they say act like echo chambers 
Source Telegram messaging service in Arabic  gmt  Dec

Liberal Englishlanguage newspaper Pakistan Today reported that according to the Prime Ministers Office PMO federal ministers signed performance agreements for the year  with the prime minister at a ceremony in Islamabad Addressing the event Khan said We will put pressure on ourselves to take our governance performance to much higher levels in our remaining twoandaquarter years He described the signing of performance agreements as a step in the right direction and said that the performance of each ministry will be judged based on the contracts and every ministry will put pressure on itself to meet its targets
Khan said his government did not have excuses anymore and that it was the time for performance now He also said that at the time of transfer of power from one government to another after the general elections the outgoing leadership should provide a complete briefing to  its successors
He pointed to the power sector and related circular debt issues and said that such a complex and complicated sector often kept him awake at night He also mentioned the growing cost of pensions as a challenge Khan said the government would focus on the agriculture sector to increase productivity and job opportunities and was seeking Chinas cooperation in the agriculture sector under the ChinaPakistan Economic Corridor Khan also referred to the transfer of powers and different subjects to the provinces under the th Amendment and said We need to review the system for better performance
Khans speech at the ceremony was the top story in the media Promilitary Englishlanguage newspaper Pakistan Observer said Time for work has come PM Imran tells ministers Most outlets however led with his remarks on the importance of preparedness with the top headline in centrist Urdu daily Jang reading Should not take power without preparation Nationalist Urdu daily NawaiWaqt meanwhile led its coverage with Was not even aware of issues for first three months Preparedness necessary for coming to power Excuses will no longer work Ministers must show performance Prime Minister 
Several television commentators also focused on the comments about preparation Kashif Abbasi the host of talk show Off the Record on ARY News TV recalled that before the  election Khan had claimed in his speeches that he had five years of experience in running the government in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa so we are well prepared Shahzeb Khanzada the host of talk show Aaj Shahzeb Khanzada Ke Saath Today with Shahzeb Khanzada on liberal proPakistan Muslim LeagueNawaz Geo News TV questioned Khans statement that his ministers had been inexperienced and noted that many of them are politicians who have served as ministers in previous governments He argued that the prime minister had not held his ministers accountable for the failures of their ministries and at most the portfolios of the ministers had been changed
Army chief warns India during visit to de facto border
Army Chief General Qamar Javed Bajwa on  December warned that any aggression from India will be met with a fitting response while referring to the recent alleged attack on a UN vehicle He made the remarks during a visit to unspecified forward areas along the Line of Control LoC the de facto border between Indianadministered and Pakistanadministered Kashmir The comments came amid heightened tensions between Pakistan and India with frequent ceasefire violations leading to reports of civilian casualties and Pakistani officials repeatedly alleging that India was planning to stage an attack On  December Pakistani government and military officials claimed that Indian troops had specifically targeted from across the LoC a UN Military Observer Group in India and Pakistan UNMOGIP vehicle carrying UN officials The UN has said a UNMOGIP vehicle was hit by an unidentified object and it is investigating the incident
Liberal Englishlanguage newspaper Dawn reported that a statement from the militarys media wing said that Bajwa had warned the Indian army that it would always get a befitting response from Pakistan to any misadventure or aggression It added that Bajwa was briefed on the latest situation particularly alleged ceasefire violations by the Indian army deliberately targeting innocent civilians along the LoC as well as the recent targeting of a United Nations vehicle by Indian troops against international norms and conventions Bajwa said Indian provocations particularly recent targeting of the UNMOGIP vehicles are a threat to regional peace and stability
Bajwas visit to the LoC received prominent coverage and reporting based on the military media wings statement Most outlets led with his warning regarding India with Pakistani nationalist Englishlanguage daily The Nation featuring the top headline Indian provocations threat to regional peace says COAS Centrist Urdu daily Dunya meanwhile framed the visit alongside the latest reported military exchanges leading with LoC Indian artillery fire woman martyred  injured Army chiefs visit to forward posts
Nadeem Malik the host of talk show Nadeem Malik Live on moderate Samaa News TV discussed the visit and said the situation on our eastern border is very tense He added that a parliamentary committee should receive an incamera briefing and discuss the situation
Ten alleged militants killed in Balochistan
The Pakistani military on  December said that  terrorists had been killed in a security operation in Awaran district of Balochistan A separatist insurgency has continued for decades in Balochistan with frequent reports of security operations and deaths of security personnel as well as killing of alleged militants
Centrist Englishlanguage daily The News quoted the militarys media wing saying that an intelligencebased operation was conducted in Awarans Gwargo area which led security forces to terrorists who were allegedly involved in an incident that had resulted in the death of a solider on  December in the Jatt Bazar area In an intense exchange of fire  terrorists were killed it said adding that a cache of arms and ammunition was recovered from the hideout

By Alex Wright

Islamic State group IS continued to grow its bases in subSaharan Africa over  with some of its branches there claiming significantly more attacks and casualties than last year
At the same time the jihadist group has ramped up its propaganda aimed at the continent promoting operations and declaring war on local rivals Christians and aid agencies
According to data collected by BBC Monitoring from ISs official media output attack claims have risen by a third in the Lake Chad Basin area  northeastern Nigeria Chad and eastern Niger
Claims from ISs selfproclaimed Central Africa Province  based in geographically separated northern Mozambique and eastern DR Congo  have more than tripled This branch also extended its reach into Tanzania in 
Meanwhile the groups Sahel affiliate which is based in Mali Burkina Faso and western Niger has seen a drop in claims against government and foreign forces as it became engaged in a new conflict with the local alQaeda affiliate Jamaat Nusrat alIslam walMuslimin JNIM
This analysis will focus on data gathered between  January  and  December  from ISs official claims disseminated by its online media distributor Nashir News Agency
Claims reported separately and haphazardly in ISs weekly paper alNaba will be addressed but because of the inconsistent nature of its coverage systematic figures have not been collated from the publication
Lake Chad  ISWAP

IS operates in the Lake Chad basin under the name of Islamic State West Africa Province which is widely known in the media by the acronym ISWAP 
ISWAP which is mainly active in Nigerias northeastern Borno state has managed to keep up the pace of its attacks over the year despite several counterinsurgency campaigns
During this period the branch claimed  casualties in  separate operations  a casualty figure more than a third higher than in 
These casualty figures have not been crosschecked against reports from authorities and the media It is worth noting that jihadist groups sometimes exaggerate the impact of their attacks
This rise in activity comes despite efforts from local governments to stamp out IS and its local jihadist rival Boko Haram which pledged allegiance to IS for a year in  before leaving the group
ISWAP is a Boko Haram faction that has remained loyal to the transnational jihadist group
In April the Nigerian Chadian and Niger armies launched a joint operation against jihadists after a devastating attack on Boma island in Lake Chad left close to  Chadian troops dead
Following the Wrath of Boma campaign which was repeatedly mocked as a failure by IS the Nigerian military announced a new military strategy of massing troops in super camps ostensibly to better protect them from jihadist forces
The scheme which was also derided by IS has so far failed to rein in the violence
Analysis Islamic State in Nigeria withstands new army strategy
The targets of ISWAPs attacks have largely been local armed forces several of which have had extremely high death tolls such as an assault in March in Nigerias northeastern Yobe State that allegedly killed up to  soldiers
Another attack in Borno in June allegedly killed  governmentbacked militiamen Mainstream media and official reports have corroborated the high casualties in both instances
In November and December IS claimed two boat bomb attacks against Chadian soldiers in Lake Chad claiming the blasts killed killed scores of troops
These operations such as those of the other African branches have been heavily promoted by IS with frontpage spreads in alNaba dedicated to the affiliates alleged exploits
The other main target of the group has been Christians and aid workers with the group officially declaring war on humanitarian agencies in August
An October audio message from ISs spokesman hammered in an antiChristian message accusing aid agencies in Africa of covertly seeking to convert poor Muslims
Over the past year ISWAP has claimed  attacks on Christians Christian villages churches and aid workers via its distinctive statements
The group has released several gruesome videos claiming to show the killing of abducted Christians and aid workers
ISWAPs propaganda this year has also sought to flaunt its power and influence The group has gloated about briefly taking over towns and published images of militants freely conducting religious outreach
Sahel  ISGS

Meanwhile the other branch of the West Africa province that is based in the Sahel has experienced a drop in its claimed attacks against local and foreign troops this year
This branch which is known in the media as Islamic State in the Greater Sahara ISGS has clearly been sidetracked as a result of infighting with the bigger and betterconnected alQaeda affiliate JNIM
Analysis Africas Sahel becomes latest alQaedaIS battleground
ISGS however did belatedly claim many operations with high casualty counts particularly against JNIM via its weekly paper alNaba  a media behaviour it also followed last year
IS via the Nashir News Agency statements reported  casualties in  attacks in the Sahel in   figures higher than this years tally of  casualties in  attacks
IS media stopped issuing timely attack claims from the region in February following a threemonth burst in activity at the end of  that saw IS militants carry out a string of devastating hitandrun raids on remote military bases
Analysis Sharp rise in Islamic State attacks in Africas Sahel
The last of these raids took place in January in western Niger and killed at least  soldiers
The end of regular IS reporting from the Sahel coincided with the start of the conflict with JNIM in Mali and Burkina Faso This may have been exacerbated by preexisting communication challenges on the ground
Since then ISs claims from the region have largely been confined to alNaba which has semiregularly published lengthy roundups of ISGS attacks against JNIM and Frenchbacked regional forces
The articles have reported that up to  JNIM fighters have been killed in the jihadist infighting this year and claimed numerous largely lowlevel operations against French and local security forces
Some of the major operations claimed via alNaba include an attack in western Niger that killed six French citizens and claims that IS militants have killed at least five French soldiers over the year in different incidents
France has been leading a coalition of West African and European allies including most recently the British army against the jihadists in the region since 
IS has continued to regularly promote the branchs impact in its propaganda In January during its unprecedented surge a minute video was released showing off combat footage from the base attacks
However much of this years media output has been dedicated to lashing out at JNIM
A November interview in alNaba with ISGSs leader laid out a timeline of the conflict and reiterated charges that JNIM had betrayed a truce and that it has been colluding with the government
Prior to the start of the fighting IS had been highly critical of JNIM holding talks with the Malian government that ultimately led to a prisoner swap in October
AlQaeda supporters and media groups online have accused IS of freezing its operations against local and foreign troops in the country to focus on fighting JNIM 
Central Africa  ISCA

The IS branch that has seen the most growth over the past year has been its socalled Central Africa province which operates in eastern DR Congo Mozambique and more recently Tanzania
This year IS reported  casualties in  operations  more than triple the previous years toll of  deaths in  attacks in the three countries
IS claimed the majority of casualties in DR Congo but larger attacks in Mozambique
The Mozambiquebased militants gained international attention this year when they briefly seized the town of Mocimboa de Praia in gasrich Cabo Delgado province in March
This branch has since claimed scores of attacks on the military including allegedly downing a helicopter in April and a subsequent shortlived second takeover of Mocimboa de Praia in August
The branch expanded its reach into southern Tanzania in October weeks after it reported clashes with the Tanzanian military in Mozambique 
Local media has pointed the finger at the militants for two massacres of around  villagers in April and November but IS has not claimed responsibility for the incidents
IS has been keen to flaunt the rapid rise of its Mozambique affiliate which was only first announced in June 
In July  an alNaba editorial taunted Western countries backing Mozambiques government The group has also released footage of militants taking over a village in the region
IS affiliates in DR Congo are active in the countrys eastern Nord Kivu province near the border with Uganda  a region that is home to several rebel groups including the Allied Democratic Forces ADF
ISs biggest attack in the country this year was in October when the group claimed responsibility for the jail break in Beni city that led to the escape of over  prisoners
Authorities have blamed that incident and many others in DR Congo on the ADF It is unclear what links IS militants there have to the larger Islamist rebel group which originated in Uganda
The DR Congo affiliate also claimed eight attacks on Christians and their villages over  including an attack in November that killed  people in the Beni region
Both Central African branches have remained highly active despite campaigns by local armed forces to rid the areas of the insurgents
Source BBC Monitoring  Dec

Aramco planning pipeline expansion to  million bd
Saudi Arabias Red Sea crude terminals have taken on critical importance since tensions with Iran have threatened the key Gulf shipping lane through the Strait of Hormuz over the past few years
Serving those ports is Saudi Aramcos  million bd EastWest Pipeline which was hit by a drone attack in May  and is still under repair according to sources but the state oil giant has been able to keep supplies flowing westward through a separate reserve network of other pipelines that run parallel
Aramco does not highlight the existence of these extra pipelines but sources familiar with the matter said they were part of the companys strategic redundancy to protect its ability to remain the worlds largest exporter of crude
It is a backup pipeline for the EastWest and is being used and that is basically to avoid any blockage through the Strait of Hormuz said one source who spoke on condition of anonymity due to the sensitivity of his work with the company
Saudi Aramco declined to comment
Another drone attack on the Abqaiq crude processing facility in the Eastern Province Saudi Arabias primary oil producing region in September  put additional emphasis on the kingdoms ability to ship crude from its west coast
 Price spike          
That attack which also hit the Khurais oil field knocked out  million bd of Saudi Arabias production  some  of prepandemic global crude demand  causing a historic spike in oil prices but Aramco was able to carry out sufficient repairs to restore full output within  days
The reserve pipeline network has allowed Aramco to restore flows to the port of Yanbu in the southwest to preattack levels since February another source who requested anonymity said
It takes time and fix the actual core infrastructure So the emergency network is still being used since the attack the source said On Aramcos legacy fields you have an emergency network It is designed to replace at least  capacity within  hours
Aramco is not utilizing crude in storage to compensate for the damage sustained from the attack the source said
The  km EastWest line runs from Abqaiq to Yanbu and was built in the s to bypass the Persian Gulf when the IranIraq war had both countries engaged in a socalled tanker war hitting oilladen ships heading for the Strait of Hormuz
Since being expanded to its current  million bd capacity in  it has rarely run at full rates with Aramco exporting the bulk of its crude from terminals in and around Ras Tanura on the Gulf
Aramco which has the exclusive right to produce and export crude in Saudi Arabia has a production capacity of about  million bd though its current output has been capped at around  million bd due to an OPEC supply accord

It has exported around  million bd in recent months according to figures from the Joint Data Organizations Initiative

In the recent Abqaiq and EastWest Pipeline attacks Iranbacked Houthi militia in Yemen have claimed responsibility as well as for several other strikes aimed at Aramco facilities and vessels

After the Abqaiq incident Aramco said it was accelerating plans to expand the pipeline to  million bd capacity According to the companys most recent international bond prospectus that project will be completed in 

But the Houthi rebels acting as proxies for Iran have increasingly targeted Aramcos operations in and around the Red Sea

 Recent attacks          

Three incidents have been reported in the past month

On Dec  an oil tanker suffered a blast in the waters off the port of Jeddah after it was hit an unmanned explosiveladen boat

On Nov  the Aframax tanker Agrari near the port at AlShuqaiq was hit by an external source according to its owner while discharging gasoline

On Nov  a missile struck a Saudi Aramco distribution station near Jeddah

Supervisor Subhash Bhowmik  JCB driver Subal Debnath  and worker Gana Mohan Tripura  were kidnapped at gunpoint by the NLFT ultras from Malda Kumar Para in eastern Tripuras Dhalai district on December  while they were engaged in borderfencing work along the international border
Bangladesh security forces had conducted a massive search operation in their territory to locate the three Indian hostages and to nab the Tripura ultras following request from Indian security forces the police official said on the condition of anonymity
Tripura Additional Director General of Police Law and Order Rajiv Singh earlier told IANS that there was information that the NLFT militants had whisked away their hostages to Bangladesh since the crime spot was just along the international border
Governmentowned National Building Construction Corporation was assigned the task to put up barbed wire fence along the IndiaBangladesh border to check crimes and infiltration bids
Litan Naths wife had told the police that a few heavily armed militants had raided their house on November  and looted jewellery cash and abducted her husband The police said that the abductors had demanded Rs  lakh in ransom for Naths release

Four NLFT cadres lay down arms in Tripura Correspondent  AGARTALA Dec   Four cadres of banned militant outfit National Liberation Front of Tripura NLFT have surrendered with arms and ammunition before Director General of Police DGP VS Yadav here today  Yadav said the surrendered militants have deposited two AK rifles an AK bayonet four magazines  rounds of AK ammunition a wireless handset and Myanmar currency Kyat They have been identified as Ratham Kaloi of Ampi area in Gomati district Joy Sadhan Jamatia of Killa in Gomati district Madhu Ranjan Noatia of Shantirbazar in South Tripura and Kuklia Tripura of Karamcherra in Dhalai district During interrogation the surrendered cadres revealed that from November  to January  as many as  leaders and cadres including three surrendered NLFT militants of Biswa Mohan faction received special training at a KYKL camp located at Taga in Myanmar along with some cadres of other militant outfits of the Northeast Yadav said The DGP said the surrendered militants had stated that the struggle for independence of Tripura is totally farce Moreover the NLFT has been reeling under severe financial and organisational crisis which influenced them to join the mainstream the DGP added Meanwhile the NLFT on Wednesday evening released three persons  Subhash Bhowmik Subal Debnath and Ganapati Tripura  who were kidnapped from Ganganagar area in Dhalai district on December  when they were on their way to their workplace They are workers of National Project Construction Corporation Ltd NPCC engaged in border fencing at Maldapara village in Dalai district under the jurisdiction of Ganganagar Police Station about  km from here A group of six insurgents armed with automatic weapons had raided the construction site bordering Chittagong Hill Tracts CHT in Bangladesh and taken away the three workers to Bangladesh According to the police the ultras were forced to release the abducted persons due to continuous operations by the security forces which also mounted pressure on overground collaborators of the insurgent outfit However another person identified as Litan Nath who was kidnapped from the Damcherra area still remains untraced A police team even visited Assam to search for Litan but could not trace him There have been reports that the abductors have demanded Rs  lakh for his safe release

NLFT insurgents release kidnapped border fencing workers after  days More than a fortnight after they were kidnapped near the Bangladesh border the three border fencing workers have been released by National Liberation Front of Tripura NLFTBM ultras Assistant Inspector General AIG of Tripura Police Subrata Chakraborty told indianexpresscom that the trio was released on Wednesday due to continuous operations by the local police and other security forces and tremendous pressure mounted on overground workers of the insurgent outfit inside Tripura Bangladeshi security forces conducted extensive search operations within their territory which prompted the ultras to lower their ante and release the hostages the official said Subhash Bhowmik Subal Debnath and Gana Mohan were kidnapped by cadres of the outlawed NLFT from an unfenced patch of IndoBangla border in Dhalai district  km away from here earlier this month The ultras crossed the international border and abducted them at gunpoint Tripura Police had said that coordinated search operations were conducted on both sides of the IndoBangla border to rescue the workers The police had also said that extensive search operations were conducted in adjoining areas on the Indian side and Indian sister agencies were in regular touch with Bangladesh authorities A few days after the kidnapping three facilitators of the insurgent outfit were detained by the state police and brought in for interrogation in connection with the abduction The trioPathan Mohan Tripura Jatindra Tripura and Baisyajoy Tripura all hailing from Malda Kumar Para in Dhalai district where the kidnapping took place were found to be involved in the abduction the police later said in a statement Sixteen days after they were taken all three returned safely on December  Though the police claim they were released due to pressure mounted on the insurgents based on interrogation of  the overground workers sources say that ransom was paid to secure their release However senior police officials have denied the claim NLFT which kidnapped the border fencing workers was formed on March   with the slogan of sovereign Tripura The outfit was outlawed in  under the Unlawful Activities Prevention Act UAPA and later under the Prevention of Terrorism Act POTA The insurgent outfit suffered a massive split as  members broke away and laid down arms before the state government in August  However a small faction of the outfit is still active which according to intelligence sleuths is hiding away across the international border in Bangladesh The Indian An unmerry Christmas for Palestinians as Militant Israeli Squatters attack Monastery Church This year there will be no Christmas celebrations in Palestine because of restrictions necessary to stop the spread of COVID Worse this unusually gloomy season was darkened further when militant Israeli squattersettlers disrupted Christian prayer at the oldest monastery in Palestine On Thursday  December hundreds of Israeli settlers gathered in order to intimidate the monks who were at the beautiful ancient monastery of St Saba near Bethlehem As a Palestinian Muslim who lived in Jerusalem for a few years and was brought up to respect other religions their followers and their right to have their own places of worship I feel horrified to read about these attacks on historic places of worship some of which I visited previously and was amazed by their ancient beautiful architecture and the historic value of every stone in Palestine This does not seem to be appreciated by the Israeli settlers who want to erase our rich and diverse history Their attacks bring to mind ISIS attacks on archaeological sites of ancient civilizations in Iraq and Syria as if extremists are united in their hatred of culture civilization and coexistence The assault on the monastery of St Saba wasnt the only attack on Christian places of worship by Israeli settlers in recent weeks On  December of this year an Israeli settler entered the Gethsemane church in East Jerusalem  poured inflammable liquid and tried to burn the church benches before he was stopped by local Palestinians who handed him over to the police Palestinian Christians and Muslims condemned the attack a local clergy spokesman Wadie Abu Nassar said that the suspect was an Orthodox Jew who set fire to the interior of the church and alleged there were possible racist motives behind the attack The chairman of the Palestinian Higher Presidential Commission for Churches Affairs Ramzy Khouri said the attack was not the first on places of worship and on Islamic and Christian sanctities especially in Jerusalem He referred to previous attack on the Church of the Multiplication of the Loaves and Fish near Tiberias as well as another attack by settlers which targeted Coptic priests in the Church of the Holy Sepulcher Mr Khouri also accused the Israeli government and settlers of attempting to weaken the Palestinian Arab presence in Jerusalem and to displace its indigenous population The Palestinian presidency also blamed the Israeli government for the attack In a statement the presidency said this attack was evidence of the brutality and savageness of the Israeli settlers who practice terrorism in plain full sight of the Israeli occupation forces The settlers who carry out such attacks are motivated by an extremist supremacist ideology deeply rooted in the Israeli far right According to the Nation  an Israeli advocate of attacks on Muslim and Christian places of worship is Benzion Gopstein He runs an extremist group called Lehava flame in Hebrew which also aims to prevent mixed relations between Jews and nonJews He defends burning churches Additionally Lehava activists attack Palestinians in the streets of Jerusalem just for being Palestinians Investigations into its funding showed that it is linked to an Israeli organization called Chemla which receives funding from the Israeli government Its funding was also linked to USbased NGOs In  and in response to the ongoing attacks on churches the church body authorized by the Vatican to oversee the Catholic Churchs property in the Holy Land wrote to Israels attorney general to indict Gopstein for inciting violence against the Christian churches and stating that he poses a threat to Holy Land Christians The letter warned that these Christians live in fear and urged Israel to find and prosecute people responsible for more than  attacks against Muslim and Christian holy sites it is alarming however that conviction rate for these crimes is very low According to the website at least  churches and mosques were vandalized between  and   of these incidents were closed without any charges against any perpetrator A few years ago I was asked to help interpreting from Arabic to English when a delegation of Palestinian church leaders visited Belfast I remember when Archbishop Atallah Hanna said that the duty of Christians is to stand for justice and to be on the side of the oppressed and the oppressed are the Palestinians This is in contrast with the fundamentalist Christians who support Trump and advocate a foreign policy biased towards Israel in order to enable it to steal more Palestinian land and to continue oppressing the Palestinians Such policies are contributing to the ethnic cleansing of not only Muslims but also of the oldest Christian community in the world from their homeland which is also the homeland of Christ himself  Bonus video added by Informed Comment TRT World Now Israeli settler arrested for IranBacked Iraqi Militants Deny Involvement in US Embassy Attack VOA  WASHINGTON  This week two Iranbacked militias in Iraq denied responsibility for a rocket attack Sunday on the US embassy in Baghdad The groups are the usual suspects when American interests come under attack in Iraq and its rare for them to publicly deny carrying out an attack on a US target But after Sundays incident which saw several small rockets land inside Baghdads fortified Green Zone wounding at least two Iraqi civilians both of the Iranian proxy groups released statements denying any role The most prominent Iranbacked group Kataib Hezbollah KH went a step further by condemning the attack as indiscriminate The bombing of the embassy of evil at this time is an uncontrolled act and the relevant authorities should follow up and arrest the perpetrators said KH in a statement published in local Iraqi media Monday We condemn the indiscriminate shelling of the military barracks of the American Embassy because it is a real threat to civilian lives it added US Secretary of State Mike Pompeo blamed the attack on proIran Shiite militias calling for the support of Iraqi people in their governments efforts to reinforce Iraqs sovereignty FILE  Secretary of State Mike Pompeo speaks to the media at the State Department Nov   in Washington The same militias targeting diplomatic facilities are stealing Iraqi state resources on a massive scale attacking peaceful protesters and activists and engaging in sectarian violence said Pompeo adding that no Americans were harmed Iraqi Prime Minister Mustafa alKadhimi this week called the attack an act of terror declaring that a number of suspects had already been arrested Yesterdays bombing of the Green Zone is a cowardly act of terrorism and the missiles landed on Iraqis and wounded them and we will not accept any attack on diplomatic missions he said Fear of retaliation While describing attacks on US military installations as legitimate Qais AlKhazali the leader of antiAmerican Asaib Ahl alHaq said in a statement that his forces will not assault diplomatic missions Targeting the bases of the American occupation is a right guaranteed by the divine laws and the laws of Earth and we will not stop until our country is liberated said AlKhazali who was once a US military detainee in Iraq   While it is not unprecedented for Iranian proxy groups to deny attacks that cause civilian casualties observers say the explicit nature of condemnation by a group such as KH appears to show the militants are concerned about shaping public perception of the attacks and their vulnerability to US airstrikes from the outgoing Trump administration The Fasail factions want to avoid retaliation for their actions so they create fake front organizations like Jabbarin and publicly denounce the attacks They are hoping to create doubt that will allow them to keep attacking said Michael Knights an Iraq analyst at the Washington Institute for Near East policy The attack appeared to increase fears among Iraqis that further instability might face their country ahead of the anniversary of the January  US drone strike that killed Iranian military commander Qassem Soleimani Militia leader and KH founder Abu Mahdi alMuhandis was also killed FILE  Iranian mourners gather during the final stage of funeral processions for slain top general Qassem Soleimani in his hometown Kerman Jan   We are concerned about the current transition in the world and any mistake in the rules of conflict could lead to escalation Iraq and the Iraqis want to spend Christmas nights in peace and security as they enter the new year Hussein Ali Allawi a professor of national security at Nahrain University in Baghdad told VOA via a messaging app Following the US killing of Soleimani and alMuhandis the Shiitecontrolled Iraqi parliament passed a nonbinding resolution that asked for the removal of US troops and other foreign forces Since then Iranbacked militias also have occasionally carried out attacks against US diplomatic facilities and military installations in Iraq

tricycle taxis  And others moved on foot accompanying their cattle she said Mantoo said another  refugees are expected to move back to Goudoubo from the Mentao camp this month  She said the Malians will have better access to services in the camp  She said  new shelters have been built health clinics have been refurbished schools are welcoming students and returning refugees have begun reopening small businesses But despite the welcome relocations we are continuing to warn that attacks by armed groups in the Sahel will lead to further displacement in the region that is already hosting  million IDPs and hundreds of thousands of refugees  Across the Sahel refugees and internally displaced people and their hosts are subjected to brutal violence rape execution  It is really horrible and now the pandemic is adding a new layer of hardships said Mantoo Burkina Faso is at the epicenter of one of the worlds fastestgrowing displacement and protection crises  The UNHCR says more than one million people in the country are internally displaced and more than  Malians have taken refuge there

todays arrests of Brittany Dawn Jeffrey  Emily Nowlin  Renea Goddard  and Aline EspinosaVillegas  all of Little Rock According to the Criminal Complaint filed on December   numerous incidents of vandalism occurred after protests were held at local police stations earlier this year On August   a large group of protestors held a demonstration at the Little Rock Police Department th Street Substation The following morning officers arriving for duty noticed that several police vehicles in their parking lot had punctured tires Officers also saw two green glass bottles with fluid inside that smelled like gasoline The bottles were examined and found to be consistent with improvised incendiary devices commonly referred to as Molotov cocktails The Complaint explains that a Molotov cocktail is typically made by using a container filled with an ignitable liquid and placing a wick in the opening of the container If the Molotov cocktail functions as designed the container will break spreading ignitable liquid which will be lit by the flaming wick According to the Complaint surveillance footage reflected that two individuals were moving near the parking lot after the protests and a flaming object can be observed being launched into the parking lot area Cooperating witnesses stated that the Molotov cocktails were assembled at Brittany Dawn Jeffreys residence The Complaint states that on August   an Arkansas State Police vehicle was vandalized and burned while stored in a fenced parking lot at Arkansas State Police Headquarters in Little Rock One vehicle had been set on fire one had been vandalized with spray paint and several others had punctured tires Investigators discovered a detonated Molotov cocktail made from a bottle of brandy Surveillance video from that incident shows three people entering the vehicle storage area wearing dark clothing and backpacks The video shows them bending down in a motion consistent with slashing vehicle tires as well as throwing a lighted object into a police vehicle The Complaint states that witnesses informed law enforcement that Renea Goddard Emily Nowlin and Aline EspinosaVillegas were responsible for the incident Federal search warrants were executed to obtain the locations of their cell phones and cell site data confirmed that their cell phones were in the location of Arkansas State Police Headquarters on August    Todays arrests send a message that violence targeted toward law enforcement will not be tolerated stated US Attorney Hiland Breaking into a police compound and fire bombing a police vehicle with a homemade explosive device is clearly not a peaceful protest Those who would target law enforcement with violent acts will not do so in the Eastern District of Arkansas without the full resources of the federal government being deployed to assist our state and local partners in bringing those responsible to justice They will be prosecuted to the fullest extent of the law We worked methodically on each of the scenes collecting evidence interviewing witnesses and following leads to help us solve these cases said ATF New Orleans Field Division Special Agent in Charge Kurt Thielhorn We were able to narrow in on particular individuals who we identified responsible for the law enforcement vehicle fires in the Little Rock area We appreciate the assistance the public was able to provide in order to bring these individuals to justice The charges in todays unsealed Complaint include malicious destruction of property belonging to an entity receiving federal funding conspiracy to commit those acts and possession of a destructive device The defendants arrested will appear before US Magistrate Judge Joe J Volpefor their initial appearance The investigation was conducted by ATF Arkansas State Police North Little Rock Police Department and Little Rock Police Department The case is being prosecuted by Assistant United States Attorney Stacy Williams A complaint Police have registered a case against unidentified persons for attacking a Chinese national who along with his interpreter escaped an attack on a car showroom on the Super HighwayAn FIR No  was registered at the Sacchal police station on the request of the showroom owner Abdul Baseer Police have also placed the Section  of the AntiTerrorism Act No suspect has been arrested so far however police are continuing with the investigations They have recorded statements and obtained CCTV footage of the crime sceneShortly after the incident a nationalist party Sindhudesh Revolutionary Army claimed the responsibility of the attack This was the second attempt to attack a Chinese national in Karachi in the recent days as earlier two unknown motorcyclists had attempted to target the Chinese owner of the China Town restaurant by fitting a magnetic improvised explosive device in his car in the upscale Clifton locality The responsibility of that incident was also claimed by the same nationalist partyOn Tuesday a Chinese national and his interpreter escaped an attack on a car showroom on the Super HighwayA Sacchal police official said that an unidentified pillion rider on a motorcycle fired shots at the showroom located near the Jamali Flyover He added that the attack was carried out when the Chinese national had been on a visit to the showroomThe official said that no casualty was reported in the incident but one of the cars had been damaged Empty shells of the pistol used in the attack had been collected from the crime sceneQuoting the showroom owner the official said the Chinese national had arrived at the showroom for the first time to purchase a car He added that the foreigner was accompanied by his interpreter and that both of them fortunately remained unhurt in the incidentThe official said that one of the suspects was wearing a shalwar kameez while the other was wearing a shirt and trousers After the firing they sped away in the direction of Quetta Town

Election monitor is among  deaths in  Kabul attacks KABUL Afghanistan  Attacks in Afghanistans capital left at least three people dead Wednesday including the head of an independent elections watchdog officials said The country has faced relentless violence even as Taliban and Afghan government negotiators hold talks in Qatar trying to hammer out a peace deal to put an end to decades of war Gunmen shot and killed Mohammad Yousuf Rasheed executive director of the nongovernmental Free and Fair Election Forum of Afghanistan said Ferdaws Faramarz a spokesman for Kabuls police chief The attack took place during Rasheeds morning commute to the organizations office in Kabul Faramarz said Rasheed was taken to Kabuls Emergency Hospital where he died Outside friends and colleagues gathered as news of the attack spread and several wept when they learned he had not survived He was a patient man who wouldnt lose his temper under any circumstances said Omid Nawrozi who worked with Rasheed He said Rasheed had been scheduled to speak about the peace talks at a news conference planned for Wednesday morning Rasheeds driver also died in a hospital Faramarz said Afghan President Ashraf Ghani condemned the attack saying in a statement that Rasheed had spent many years working to institutionalize democracy and transparency in the electoral process By carrying out such attacks the enemies can not push back the current Afghanistan which has achieved recent progress and achievements with the tireless efforts and sacrifices of the people he said Nader Nadery who preceded Rasheed as head of the election monitoring group and now serves as a senior Afghan government official and delegate to the peace talks in Qatar praised Rasheeds passion and commitment to making this a country where the people would ultimately be the decisionmakers Ross Wilson the US ranking diplomat in Afghanistan tweeted that Rasheed was a dedicated and steadfast advocate for representative democracy in the country He worked tirelessly for years to ensure free and transparent elections that engaged all Afghans Wilson said His death is a loss for his family friends and nation In a separate attack in Kabul a police vehicle was targeted by a sticky bomb in the eastern part of the city The blast killed a police officer and wounded two others according to Faramarz No one immediately claimed responsibility for either attack but the Islamic State militant group has said it was behind a number of attacks in Kabul in recent months including on educational institutions The Taliban meanwhile are known to cover their tracks on civilian deaths by implicating the other group The Islamic State took responsibility for a Tuesday attack in which a roadside bomb tore through a vehicle and killed five people three of them doctors on their way to work at Kabuls main penitentiary Among the dead was Nazefa Ibrahimi the acting health director of the prison Another doctor was in serious condition The militant group said it had targeted prison administrators The victims car a white sedan did not appear to have any markings that indicated its passengers were medical workers Information for this article was Ethiopia deploys forces to ethnic region after deadly violence Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed has ordered the deployment of military forces to the countrys volatile west after armed attackers killed scores of people along ethnic border lines in the region The massacre of civilians in BenishangulGumuz region is very tragic Abiy said in a Twitter post on Thursday The government to solve the root causes of the problem has deployed a necessary force The staterun Ethiopian Human Rights Commission announced a day earlier that gunmen had killed over  people in a dawn attack on a village in Bulen County in the western BenishangulGumuz region an area where numerous ethnic groups live Amnesty International which spoke with five survivors said members of the ethnic Gumuz community had attacked the homes of ethnic groups of Amhara Oromo and Shinasha setting them on fire and stabbing and shooting residents The rights group said that the Gumuz see minorities as settlers and that dozens of people were still unaccounted for Abiy and senior officials had visited the region earlier in the week to call for calm after multiple deadly attacks in recent months including a November  assault in which gunmen targeted a bus and killed  people The attacks are separate from the deadly conflict in Ethiopias northern Tigray region where Ethiopian forces and allied regional forces began fighting Tigray regional forces in early November The United Nations UN and aid agencies have been pressing for safe access to Tigray which is home to more than  million people and where  were dependent on food aid even before the conflict began last month SS

The border demarcation negotiations between Sudanese and Ethiopian government delegations in Khartoum were concluded yesterday afternoon without any results
The Sudanese delegation was headed by Omar Manis Minister of Cabinet Affairs while the Ethiopian side was headed by Demeke Mekonnen the Ethiopian Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Affairs Minister
Sources say that the negotiations failed because the Ethiopian delegation refused to recognise the  border demarcation saying that the BritishEthiopian treaty on the border was signed in colonial times
In a joint statement the two parties said that both delegations exchanged views only They will submit their reports to their governments The next meeting will be held in Addis Ababa at a date to be determined later
The Sudanese armed forces reported earlier this week that they recaptured territories in the areas of Salam Bir and Mahaj in El Gedaref from Ethiopian forces At the same time Ethiopian troops and militiamen launched a series of new attacks in which a shepherd was injured
Last week the Sudanese army stated that Ethiopian forces ambushed Sudanese troops killing four and wounding 
Earlier this month the Sudan Armed Forces SAF regained control of tKhor Yabis in El Fashaga in eastern El Gedaref The area was occupied by Ethiopian farmers and gunmen called shifta in the region for more than  years
The  kilometre border between Sudan and Ethiopia was drawn in colonial times No clear demarcation of the border has been made since Sudan became independent in  The lack of clear border markers has made it easy for Ethiopian militants to occupy fertile farmlands in eastern El Gedaref
Ethiopian farmers have been cultivating crops for decades along the border These lands are protected by Ethiopian gunmen Farmers in El Fashaga backed by the El Gedaref governor demanded in July that these lands be returned to them

Ethiopian refugees from Tigray
The Sudanese Refugee Commission reported that  new Ethiopian refugees fleeing the war in neighbouring Tigray entered Sudan this week They passed the border crossings Hamdayet in Kassala and Village  in El Gedaref In total  Ethiopian refugees have sought refuge in Sudan since early November
 of them remain in reception centres near the border They are supposed to be transferred to the Um Rakouba refugee camp in El Gedaref but transport has stopped since Monday
On November  Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed announced a military offensive against the Tigray Peoples Liberation Front TPLF an ethnically based political party that dominated the Ethiopian government for almost  years until Abiy came to power in 
Abiy accussed the TPLF of attacking Ethiopian army bases in Tigray in order to loot military equipment In retaliation Abiys cabinet declared a sixmonth State of Emergency in the region and ordered airstrikes and an offensive The Ethiopian army took Tigrays capital Mekelle at the end of November The Tigray leadership retreated north

farming communities in Kaduna state are experiencing renewed violence and abductions by armed assailants of Fulani ethnicity On  December Mrs Jumai Luka the wife of Rev Luka Shaho of Assemblies of God Church in Ungwan Waziri in Chikun Local Government LGA central Kaduna state was abducted by armed men who had beaten her husband mercilessly On  December Reverend Thomas James of Godiya Baptist Church Gwazunu was abducted following an attack by over  wellarmed men on the Gwazunu community in Gwagwada Chikun LGA The militia went on to attack the Gbaja Katarma community where eight people were killed and four reportedly sustained gunshot injuries According to information received by the media house War Desk  villagers subsequently fled to the Sarkin Pawa community in neighbouring Niger state as attacks continued and assistance was not forthcoming On  December Rev Luka Dani of the Evangelical Church Winning All ECWA was abducted following at attack on the Galumi community in Gwagwada Chikun LGA Several villagers had reportedly been abducted from Kugosi and surrounding communities a week prior to this attack Rev Dani was eventually released on  December and has now left the area On  December  people were killed and  homes burnt down during an attack by armed men of Fulani ethnicity on Gora Gan village in Zangon Kataf LGA in the Atyap Chiefdom in southern Kaduna state Five of the victims were from the same family The attack constitutes the latest violation of a much vaunted peace accord  the most infamous breach being the murders on  November of the District Head of MaZaki Mr Haruna Kuye and his son Destiny  Mr Kuyes wife and daughter survived the attack despite suffering severe injuries In a letter addressed to the Chief Executive of Zagon Kataf Local Government Council dated  December the Ikulu Traditional Council warned that the Government Secondary School in Unwan Gimba was being used as a base by unidentified armed men These men who were suspected of being responsible for the attack on Gora Gan had killed a local youth and forced the inhabitants to flee the area to nearby villages for their safety Elsewhere on  December armed men riding in pairs on motorcycles attacked Kujeni Tudu in Kajuru LGA southern Kaduna killing Bala Umaru  and looting the village According to the Southern Kaduna Peoples Union  SOKAPU  four people went missing after the attack They were named as Dada Bulus  Peter Tanko  Buba Yakubu  and Emma Dauda  CSWs Founder President Mervyn Thomas said We offer our condolences to those who lost loved ones in this months attacks in Kaduna state and our thoughts are with those whose family members are still missing or injured The urgent and deteriorating situation in Kaduna must not be forgotten nor must the religious element to these attacks be brushed aside The authorities must develop a comprehensive security plan that considers the different dimensions to this security crisis amid signs that the violence is not only continuing but has also spread to other areas Inadequate official intervention to address ongoing violence by armed men of Fulani ethnicity on Christian farming communities in central Nigeria and a concomitant proliferation of light arms has occasioned a general rise in lawlessness which terrorist factions based in the northeast increasingly exploit This situation is particularly stark in the north west where armed bandits of Fulani ethnicity largely target Hausa Muslim farming communities Recent events in Katsina state where the release of  boys abducted from their school in Kankara allegedly in exchange for a ransom was followed immediately by the rescue of around  Quranic students from Mahuta by local vigilantes have highlighted both the critical levels of insecurity in the country and the growing nexus between terrorist factions from the north east and rural banditry in the northwest Reports emerged on  December of the death of Pastor Kabiru Babangida a convert to Christianity who worked in remote villages in the north western states of Kebbi and Niger The pastor was abducted and hacked to death by assailants who had initially demanded N million in ransom before raising the amount to N million then switching off their phones Villagers subsequently decided to search for the pastor and eventually found his bound and mutilated corpse The pastor is survived by his wife and two children as well as by his parents and siblings who had disowned him due to his conversion Attacks are also occurring in the south of the country with increasing frequency On  December Fulani assailants stormed the prayer retreat of the Christ Apostolic Church CAC near Abeokuta in Ogun state at around  am stealing cash phones and other valuables from the worshipers Several pastors and worshipers were attacked with machetes and three women were abducted for ransom including the wife of a senior pastor Mervyn Thomas continued More must be done to address Nigerias security vacuum  to stem the staggering loss of life across the nation and to assist compensate and rehabilitate victims of violence There is a pressing need for an overhaul of the entire security structure including with regards to intelligence gathering coordinating action between the security services and equipping troops in a manner commensurate with terrain and challenges A holistic security strategy must be formulated as a matter of urgency given the increasing links between what may have initially appeared to be disparate sources of violence

Voters in the chronically unstable central African country go to the polls on  December in an election that is threatened by a powerful rebel alliance and serious fears of a violent fallout
Some  million registered voters are expected to cast ballots to choose a president and  legislators
The CAR is still reeling from years of sectarian violence that followed the  rebellion by Muslim Seleka rebels who ousted then President Francois Bozize Ensuing clashes between Seleka rebels and Christian antiBalaka militia destabilised the mineralrich country
Some armed groups and the opposition Democratic Opposition Coalition COD want the election to be postponed Violence marred voter registration and election campaigns in rebelheld areas
A  peace agreement signed by  rebel groups and the government has unravelled Armed groups control many parts of the CAR including some lucrative diamond and gold mines
See Names in the News Saviours and saboteurs of CAR peace deal
Rebel threats and coup claims
President Faustin Archange Touadera has accused Bozize of mobilising a rebel coalition to stage a coup after the Constitutional Court nullified the former leaders candidacy in the vote
The rebel coalition called the Coalition of Patriots for Change CPC is made up of six armed groups The Union for Peace in the Central African Republic UPC the Patriotic Movement for the Central African Republic MPC Return Reclamation Rehabilitation R the Popular Front for the Renaissance of the Central African Republic FPRC and two antiBalaka factions
The prominent Corbeau News website had reported on  December that there was speculation that Bozize was recruiting a militia to march to Bangui Bozize has denied the allegations
Local media have reported several attacks blamed on the CPC in the restive northwest and southwest regions
On  December rebels overran the southwestern town of Mbaiki km from Bangui On  December the rebels seized the fourth town of Bambari km northeast of Bangu before the UN troops Minusca and the national army took back control
CAR sought intervention from neighbouring Rwanda and its emerging military ally Russia which sent  military instructors
French fighter jets overflew parts of CAR to show Frances condemnation of attempts at destabilisation the Elysee Palace said France which intervened to end the  unrest has about  forces supporting the  Minusca force
Chad has rejected media reports that it has sent troops to CAR to support the rebels
Main presidential candidates
The Constitutional Court cleared  candidates for the presidential election A runoff will take place on  February if none of the candidates attains  in the first round
Bozize has urged the opposition to back a single candidate against Touadera
Faustin Archange Touadera

President Faustin Touadera is seeking reelection as the United Hearts Movement MCU candidate
He was appointed prime minister in  by Bozize and was vicepresident of Bozizes Kwa Na Kwa KNK party
He was elected president in 
Anicet Georges Dologuele

Former Prime Minister Anicet Dologuele is the Central African Union for Renewal URCA candidate He won the first round of the December  presidential election then lost to Touadera in the second round in February 
Bozize backed him in the  vote The renowned economist also previously served as finance minister
Catherine SambaPanza

Catherine SambaPanza is an independent candidate who served as transitional president between January  and March 
She succeeded Michel Djotodia who came to power after Bozize was ousted by Seleka rebels in 
As president SambaPanza requested the International Criminal Court ICC to probe crimes committed in the CAR and oversaw several peace attempts
Mahamat Kamoun

Mahamat Kamoun served as prime minister under former transitional President SambaPanza between August  and April  He was the first Muslim to serve in the post
He held several senior posts in the Ministry of Finance when Bozize was in power between  and 
He later served chief of staff to Djotodia
Other candidates
Others seeking the presidency are Jean Serge Bokassa  the son of the former leader JeanBedel Bokassa former prime ministers Martin Ziguele and Nicolas Tiangaye longtime ally of Bozize Cyriaque Gonda former interim parliament Speaker AlexandreFerdinand Nguendet and former Speaker Abdou Karim Meckassoua
The sons of two former CAR leaders Sylvain Eugene Ngakoutou Patasse and Desire Bilal Nzanga Kolingba are also contesting
The other candidates are Benderet Crepin MboliGoumba Elois Anguimate Serge Ghislain Djorie Augustin Agou and Aristede Briand Reboas
Russian economic and security interests
The Kremlin has expressed concern over rising political tensions Russia has made significant security contributions in CAR since mid
In August  Russia sent light weapons and  military instructors to CAR as part of a joint security agreement Russia also provides security for President Touadera
In  during a visit to Moscow Touadera sought additional military aid and Russias intervention in lifting the UN arms embargo
Covert operations in CAR have allegedly involved Russian mercenaries from the Wagner private military company that is under US sanctions
In exchange for supporting the government Moscow has reportedly been prospecting for minerals including diamonds in some of rebelheld areas 
Fake news and key media sources
There have been rising concerns about misinformation and fake news in the run up to the election In midNovember Minusca reported that a disinformation campaign has incited hostility towards UN peacekeepers
On  December Facebook announced that it had removed dozens of accounts alleging Russian interference in the December vote

Tuesday began with shocking news in the capital Kabul when Kabul police reported that a bomb explosion in the seventh district of the capital had taken the lives of five people including four doctors of the Pule Charkhi prison facility
Following that incident the Afghanistan prisons affairs authority reported that the vehicle of the head of the health department of the prisons affairs authority had also been targeted with a roadside bomb
Other officials who were killed in the attack were the deputy head of the health directorate of the prisons affairs authority Abdul Matin a driver at the department Abdul Nabi and Dr Sona an employee of the Ministry of Public Health who was sent to the authority for Covid tests for prisoners
Kabul has been a scene of repeated bomb explosions over the recent days A bomb explosion and a suicide attack left two people dead and two others wounded two days ago A day earlier MP Khan Muhammad Wardaks vehicle was attacked with a bomb in Spin Kelay area of the fifth district of Kabul
Elsewhere in Ghazni province head of Ghazni journalists union Rahmatullah Nikzad was assassinated by armed men on his way from home to the mosque
Nikzad was the fifth journalist to be killed in less than a month
Before that Enekas TV presenter Malalay Maiwand was killed in an armed attack in Nangarhar province
Radio Azadi local reporter Ilyas Daee was killed in a bomb blast in Helmand province on  Aqrab  November
Prior to that TOLOnews presenter Yama Siawash was killed in a bomb blast in Kabul
The spate of targeted attacks on civilians reporters and doctors has raised serious concerns and questions Diplomatic offices of the European Union NATO Australia the United States Canada Norway and the UK issued a joint statement on  Qaws  December to condemn deliberate and targeted attacks on the media representatives civil society members religious leaders and groups human rights activists students and civilians in Afghanistan They described these brutal attacks as attacks on the peace process
Reporters San Frontieres RSF Afghan Journalists Safety Committee AJSC and International Media Support have also said in their most recent statement that press freedom and the expansion of the media landscape is one of the most significant achievements of Afghanistan in the last two decades Unfortunately given the countrys political and security challenges this achievement is extremely vulnerable There are serious concerns that with the escalation of insecurity and conflict this achievement would perish Despite Afghan journalists courage and dedication to continue their profession the rise of threats and violence against them is shrinking the environment
The government of Afghanistan holds a press conference after every security incident to condemn the attack It accuses the Taliban of carrying out these attacks in a bid to compensate for their defeat
Taliban however have been issuing statements after every incident to reject involvement in them
Authorities have reported having arrested the perpetrators of some attacks while also claiming that Taliban terror cells have become more active in the capital Kabul and other cities
Reporting about his  am meetings First Vice President Amrullah Saleh has written that for the Taliban their Doha agreement with the United States means killing more to extract greater concessions This time they have adopted the tactic to form small cells comprised of three to fivemembers When one cell is eliminated they activate the second and third cells he has added
It is clear that the government of Afghanistan has failed to stop targeted attacks on reporters and civilians The  meetings chaired by the first vice president have so far only presented statistics and condemned the attacks In some cases investigations have been promised at these meetings but it is not clear where the governments investigation will end
Siawashs family claims that the government is not investigating in a serious fashion their sons murder case MPs have also raised questions about how Siawash was assassinated as well as about the Central Banks refusal to cooperate with the investigation process
Attacks on doctors reporters and other targeted assassinations which have increased recently have created serious fears and concerns Many journalists no longer feel safe
In view of the above the government of Afghanistan must do more and act faster to stop these incidents The government has a duty to protect civilians Reporters doctors and civilians are the most defenceless people of this country and more vulnerable to terrorist attacks The government and other warring groups in Afghanistan are bound by international laws to protect civilians They must pay closer attention to this issue

Islamic States subSaharan affiliates expand operations
The Islamic State group IS grew its operations in subSaharan Africa in  with some of its branches claiming significantly more attacks and casualties than last year
According to data collected by BBC Monitoring from ISs official media output attack claims have risen by a third in the Lake Chad Basin area  northeastern Nigeria Chad and eastern Niger
Claims from ISs selfproclaimed Central Africa Province  based in geographically separated northern Mozambique and eastern DR Congo  have more than tripled
Meanwhile the groups Sahel affiliate which is based in Mali Burkina Faso and western Niger has seen a drop in claims against government and foreign forces as it became engaged in a new conflict with the local alQaeda affiliate Jamaat Nusrat alIslam walMuslimin JNIM

Opposition presidential candidates who have been demanding the dissolution of the poll body immediately rejected the election timetable
