spy on Americans a new report indicated As The Daily Mail reported neighbors have described the person of interest in the blast that rocked the downtown area on Christmas morning as an oddball who kept to himself and was often seen tinkering with an antenna above his home They said he had No Trespassing signs around his home and his RV which could be seen on video from Google Maps parked in his backyard one that appeared similar to the one caught on surveillance cameras around the site of the bombing Reports indicated that police responded to reports of shots being fired near the ATT building in downtown Nashville in the early morning hours on Friday They found an RV parked there with a recording warning people to evacuate the area due to an imminent explosion The bomb exploded at close to  am CBS News noted a blast that shook buildings and shattered windows Three people were injured and police believe Warner may have been killed in the bombing The impact of the blast reportedly interrupted some technology services with stores reporting that credit card machines were not working the day after the incident The Daily Mail noted the FBI is now investigating the allegation that Warner was paranoid about G technology and that he believed it was being used to spy on Americans There are few other details known about Warner who is described as a yearold White man The incident is still under investigation but law enforcement sources told CBS News that they are looking into whether Warner was killed at the scene The report claimed that DNA testing is being conducted on human remains that were found in the area At least three people were wounded and Nashville Metro police chief John Drake said Friday that authorities had found tissue they believe could be connected to human remains near the site of the explosion the report noted They have not indicated whether the remains are from someone connected to the explosion or from an innocent victim The motive for the attack is still under investigation as well though FBI agent Doug Korneski told CBS News there is no indication that there are any additional explosives embedded content As The Inquisitr reported some speculated it may have been an act of domestic terrorism noting that the circumstances appeared similar to past attacks within the United States

Nashville explosion Questions remain as investigation enters Day  Questions about motive and a perpetrator still swirl as the investigation into the Christmas morning explosion in Nashville moves into a third day  Follow along here as we report updates in the case and its aftermath  Early morning explosion Nashville police responded to a report of shots fired and discovered a suspicious RV parked outside an ATT building near Second Avenue and Commerce Street just before  am Friday Officers and witnesses heard a broadcast coming from the RV giving a dire warning Evacuate now There is a bomb A bomb is in this vehicle and will explode  A  significant explosion occurred around  am As of early Saturday evening a motive in the explosion had not been released by investigators including the FBI leading the investigation  Nashville Police Chief John Drake confirmed police found tissue at the scene that could be human remains Authorities will examine it to determine what it is Drake said it was unclear if anyone was inside the RV when it exploded A person of interest had been identified in connection with the Christmas day explosion in Nashville a law enforcement source confirmed Saturday  The individual was not named publicly nor was information released on their potential whereabouts The investigation  Investigators with the FBI ATF and the Metro Nashville Police Department converged to the  block of Bakertown Road in Antioch just before  am  No arrests were made at the residence as of Saturday evening Neighbors told The Tennessean an RV similar to the one in the explosion was parked at the home within the last two weeks There was no sign of a similar vehicle at the Antioch residence on Saturday as teams from the ATF and the FBI cleared and searched the unoccupied home The FBI said more than  tips have been reported in the past  hours The investigation continues including working with its behavioral analysis unit in Quantico  Drake reiterated Saturday that no additional known threats had been identified as of Saturday evening  Let me reiterate that Nashville is safe We feel and know that we have no known threats at this time he said Saturday  Police representatives said Saturday afternoon investigators are also still trying to determine the source of the sound of gunshots reported by witnesses Friday morning before the explosion MNPD spokesperson Don Aaron told The Tennessean it was unclear if the sound came from inside the RV the recording it played or elsewhere  At least three people were hospitalized and released after they were treated for minor injuries authorities said  Traffic around downtown is being rerouted away from the wide investigation perimeter The downtown area will be sealed off for further investigation and to make sure everything is completely safe Mayor John Cooper said  He signed an order putting a curfew in place from until  pm Sunday The areas affected are bounded by James Robertson Parkway Fourth Avenue North Broadway and the Cumberland River Cleanup ahead Gov Bill Lee on Saturday requested assistance for Nashville in the wake of the explosion from the the Federal Emergency Management Agency  Lee asked FEMA to help with debris removal and emergency protective measures The request was made through the Public Assistance program under the Robert T Stafford Disaster Relief and Emergency Assistance Act  Cooper said Second Avenue will look like a construction site in the months to come  He hoped cleanup could start next week but said checking the structural integrity of buildings was the first step in the process One building collapsed At least  businesses in the area were damaged in connection to the explosion The American Red Cross has set up a reception center at East Park Community Center  Woodland St for victims displaced or affected by the explosion ATT outage continues ATT internet and phone service were was disrupted in the area about  pm Friday causing widespread outages across the region that continued into Saturday evening disrupting customer service and  access  The outages were reported several hours after the explosion took place near an ATT facility  The company had been forced to drill holes into the outside of the building to begin to reattach power to the affected equipment They also brought in at least six mobile cell towers and  announced on Saturday afternoon that some services in the Lexington Kentucky area had been restored although other areas continued to see connectivity issues into the evening  Most of the Metro Nashville Police Departments administrators and officers use ATT  and their phones went down Friday according to spokesperson Kris Mumford Mumford confirmed the department uses FirstNet ATTs proprietary network for public safety agencies and first responders

JAMMU Dec  Poonch Police and Army today foiled a major plot by the militants to trigger communal tension in Poonch district with arrest of three militants of newly floated JK Ghaznavi Force in Mendhar area who were planning to target religious places of minorities starting with famous temple of Ari Six grenades have so far been recovered from their possession
Apart from three arrests two more persons gave been detained for questioning
SSP Poonch Ramesh Angral told the Excelsior that the arrested militants were planning to carry out a grenade attack on a religious place at Ari in Mendhar at the behest of their Pakistani handler to disturb peace and communal amity in the district
The ploy was revealed after Special Operations Group SOG of the local police along with troops of the  Rashtriya Rifles detained two brothers  Mustafa Iqbal Khan and Murtaza Iqbal of Galhuta village  from their vehicle bearing No  JKBG near Basooni in Mendhar sector at around  pm yesterday Click here to watch video
Their interrogation was conducted at the  Rashtriya Rifles Battalion headquarters Basooni and it was found that Mustafa had received a call from a Pakistani number and was directed to execute the grenade attack
On being questioned further he admitted to have been tasked with throwing a grenade at a temple in Ari village A video on how to use a grenade was also found in his phone Angral said adding WhatsApp calls have been detected in mobile telephones of the militants in which their Pakistan based handler is asking them to target temples in Poonch district They had selected Ari temple for the first attack
The SSP said it came to light that Mustafa was involved in militant activities and on his confession two of his associates  Mohammad Yaseen and Rayees Ahmad of Dabbi village of Balakote near the Line of Control LoC  were also apprehended

Asked about the link between the arrested persons and the December  encounter in Dogrian village of Poonch which left two Pakistani militants dead sources said it is the followup of that very operation
We are investigating the route which they the slain militants used to enter into this side from across the LoC and the persons whom they had contacted Whether these persons have any direct link with them is part of the investigation sources further said
Jammubased Army PRO Lt Col Devender Anand said that with the arrest of the militants the security forces have unearthed a nexus of local militants who were involved in ferrying warlike stores and narcotics after smuggling them from across the border
Other officials said some posters of TehreekulMujahideen terror outfit were also recovered during the operations threatening to intensify attacks on the security forces

Authorities have been searching a twostory suburban house in the Nashville area as they probe the huge blast that ripped through the downtown of the southern US city on Christmas morning Police and federal agents were scouring the charred site of a Christmas Day explosion in Nashville on Saturday
Investigators have also been evaluating the possibility that the blast was likely the result of a suicide bombing according to a report in CNN
They said they were sifting through more than  leads and tips and that sweeps of the area found no further explosive devices
Following up on these  leads local police and agents from the FBI and US Bureau of Alcohol Tobacco Firearms and Explosives ATF were searching a twostory redbrick house on Bakertown Road in Antioch Tennessee  miles  km southeast of Nashville paying particular attention to its basement
The bomb blast injured at least three people and damaged some  buildings No deaths have been confirmed but authorities were examining tissue found at the blast site that they believe could be human remains
Police say the blast was an intentional act but the motive remained unclear and FBI behavioral analysts were involved in the investigation
US media reports said a yearold person of interest was identified in connection with the explosion which came from a parked motorhome that blared a warning minutes before it blew up
No one has been arrested but information developed during the course of the investigation led us to this address an FBI spokesman said in an interview with the Nashville Tennessean newspaper outside the home being searched 
At a separate press conference authorities on Saturday declined to name a person of interest in connection with the explosion but CBS News reported that the investigation has honed in on yearold Anthony Quinn Warner who recently lived at the Bakertown address 
According to a document posted online on November  he signed over the property to a woman in Los Angeles at no cost to her The document was signed by Warner but not by the woman
Other media reports said neighbours had previously spotted a motorhome outside the residence that was being searched Saturday by authorities and that it appeared to be similar to the one that exploded in Nashville
The investigation included some  FBI agents analysts and other staff
The governor toured the site on Saturday and said he had asked President Donald Trump to declare a state of emergency a technical move that triggers federal assistance in repairing damage
According to a timeline provided by the authorities police were called to the area to respond to gunfire at  am and officers spotted the motorhome at  am
Fifteen minutes later they heard an audio countdown coming from the vehicle warning of a bomb  interspersed with music  and the need to evacuate
Police have not said if anyone was inside the motorhome at the time but lauded the officers who arrived at the scene and took quick action
A total of  businesses were damaged Mayor John Cooper said
Adding to the cryptic nature of Fridays incident was the eerie preamble described by witnesses  a crackle of gunfire followed an apparently computergenerated female voice from the RV reciting a minutebyminute countdown to an impending bomb blast
Police scrambled to evacuate nearby homes and buildings and called for a bomb squad which was still en route to the scene when the RV blew up just outside an ATT Inc office building where it had been parked
The explosion occurred about two blocks from Lower Broadway where some of Nashvilles famous live music venues are located The Ryman Auditorium former home of the Grand Ole Opry and just three blocks from the blast scene was undamaged The Gaylord Opryland and current Grand Ole Opry complexes which sit outside the downtown area were not impacted
The motorhome was parked in front of a building for phone company ATT causing damage that disrupted telecommunications service in Tennessee as well as parts of Mississippi Kentucky Alabama and Georgia
ATTs efforts to restore services overnight were waylaid when a fire reignited at the companys downtown office at the site of the blast but the company said in a statement on Saturday it was deploying portable cell sites to downtown Nashville and across the region

A senior Houthi rebel commander has dismissed Israeli statements about Yemen saying they aimed to reassure normalising countries in remarks to the website of rebelrun AlMasirah TV
This year the United Arab Emirates UAE and Bahrain have both signed USbrokered agreements to normalise relations with Israel

He accused Israel of supporting the Saudiled coalition fighting the rebels logistically since  and of trying to find justifications to gain a military foothold in normalising countries
We are in favour of security in the Red Sea and freedom of navigation but the coalition of aggression must know that if the Red Sea front ignites escalation will be big alRuwaishan was quoted by AlMasirah as saying

Earlier this month Saudi Arabia said an oil tanker was attacked by an explosiveladen boat while it was anchored at the Red Sea port of Jeddah Iran said that it respects maritime security

If the Zionist entity takes any rash action that affects Yemen any interests of this entity and its partners in the Red Sea will become a legitimate target he added

A local official of the Afghan National Directorate of Security NDS has been killed in a mine blast in the southern province of Helmand the Pakistanbased private Afghan Islamic Press AIP news agency reported on  December The head of the local council in the provinces Nawa district named the dead man as Agha Mir Wadan  the intelligence director for Nawa district One of his bodyguards was killed and three others wounded in the blast A few days ago a brother of Mr Wadan was killed in a helicopter crash in the same district and around  days ago his father was killed by the Taliban for cooperating with the government the report added Afghan Islamic Press news agency in Pashto  Dec 
Blast kills one policeman injures two in west Afghanistan
A landmine explosion targeted a vehicle of the police force guarding the KhafHerat Railroad connecting Iran with Afghanistan in Zendajan district of western Herat province killing one policeman and injuring two others the private Pakistanbased Afghan Islamic Press AIP reported on  December Afghan Islamic Press news agency in Pashto  Dec 
Two Taliban four progovernment militia killed in north Afghanistan
Two Taliban militants have been killed and two others have been injured in an explosion in Afghanistans northern Takhar province and four members of the antiTaliban uprising forces governmentbacked antiTaliban militia have been killed and another injured in an attack in Dashte Archi district of northern Kunduz province the Pakistanbased private Afghan Islamic Press AIP reported on  December   A polices spokesman in Takhar said a mine kept by the Taliban in a house in the Akbar Khan area on the TakharKonduz highway had accidentally exploded killing the two militants and seriously injuring two others In the Kunduz incident a resident of the Sultan Bai area said that two members of the governmentbacked antiTaliban militia had opened fire on their colleagues killing four members of the forces and wounding another Afghan Islamic Press news agency in Pashto  Dec 
Source BBC Monitoring  Dec

ProalQaeda media group incites attacks in West during holiday season
A highprofile proalQaeda media group has called on sympathisers in the West to carry out attacks during the Christmas and New Year holiday season to avenge Muslims killed in Muslimmajority countries Thabat news agency published the incitement on  December via its accounts on the messaging app Telegram and on the decentralised platform RocketChat The article said the festive season of the Crusaders offers Muslim mujahidin heroes living in the lands of the Crusade a golden opportunity to take revenge It urged them to hurry up and carry out attacks for there are only a few days left of the holiday season Jihadists commonly increase their calls for attacks in the run up to and during the Christmas and New Year holiday season IS supporters online have been sharing posters inciting such attacks in the past few days Telegram messaging service in Arabic  Dec 
MIDDLE EAST
Suspected IS bomb kills one in Kurdishcontrolled eastern Syria
A Kurdish man was killed in the explosion of a roadside bomb said to have been planted by Islamic State IS in an area in eastern Syria controlled by Kurdishled Syrian Democratic Forces SDF media outlets have reported The man named as Suhail Yusuf Ahmed alTamr died while travelling on a road in the eastern province of Deir alZour on  December the Syrian Kurdish Hawar News Agency ANHA reported on the same day The blast was also reported by the UKbased Syrian Observatory for Human Rights SOHR war monitor which said that the attack comes in light of the dramatic increase in the activity of IS cells in the province BBC Monitoring in Arabic  Dec

Armed forces kill  militants in central Mali attack
The official website of the Malian Armed Forces FAMa reported on  December that  terrorists were killed during an attack by militants on an army convoy between Dinangourou and Mondoro Mopti region centre on  December It added that no army members were killed in the incident Malian Armed Forces FAMa website Bamako in French  Dec

Many people are feared dead after suspected Boko Haram gunmen attacked at least three villages in northeastern Nigeria on  December the privatelyowned Sahara Reporters website has reported The attackers raided Debiro Tashan Alade and Tirgitu vilages in Borno state An unnamed source told Sahara Reporters that the assailants arrived in  pickup trucks mounted with guns and began to fire indiscriminately at anything within sight They also burnt down two churches The Channels TV network said a fourth village was also attacked A day earlier suspected Boko Haram militants killed six people and burnt down a church in Chibok town in Borno state BBC Monitoring on  Dec

Special Forces from the Kenyan military have raided and destroyed an alShabab camp in the Boni Forest of Lamu County in the countrys coastal region privatelyowned Citizen TV website reported The dawn raid early on  December reportedly killed four militants from the Somaliabased alShabab jihadist group and recovered communication equipment and weapons Four days ago alShabab militants abducted and beheaded a village chief in Wajir County northeastern Kenya prompting the Kenyan security forces to embark on a search mission Citizen Digital website  Dec 
AlShabab targets army bases in southern Somalia
ProAlShabab news website Somali Memo reported on  December that alShabab fighters had attacked several Amisom African Union Mission to Somalia bases on the outskirts of the capital Mogadishu It said the first attack targeted a government army base in Alamada village which is located between Mogadishu and Afgoye towns Another attack also targeted an Amisom troops base in Elasha Biyaha village specifically in Dorale area Somali Memo website in Somali  Dec

By BBC Monitoring
Many people are feared dead after suspected Boko Haram gunmen attacked at least three villages in northeastern Nigeria on  December the privatelyowned Sahara Reporters website has reported
The attackers raided Debiro Tashan Alade and Tirgitu vilages in Borno state
Many persons are feared dead as gunmen suspected to be Boko Haram terrorists on Saturday night attacked three communities in the Hawul Local Government Area of Borno state the website reported
An unnamed source told Sahara Reporters that the assailants came in about  pickup trucks mounted with guns and began to fire indiscriminately at anything within sight
They also burnt down two churches
The Channels TV network said a fourth village was also attacked
Terrified villagers were said to have hidden in nearby mountains except for the old and the sick that were feared to be stuck in the mayhem it reported
Channels Television learned that despite distress calls to the military the terrorists were not repelled adding that the villages attacked today are not remote and the attacks were unexpected
A day earlier suspected Boko Haram militants killed six people and burnt down a church in Chibok town in Borno state 
On Christmas Eve the socalled Islamic State group IS group claimed responsibility for a deadly attack on a Christian village in the northeastern state of Adamawa
Elsewhere in Nigeria at least two people were killed in a stampede at a music festival in the central state of Benue on Christmas Day the privatelyowned Vanguard website reported
The site said the event had hardly started around  pm when the sound of gunshots allegedly fired by one of the policemen said to be on duty at the event triggered a stampede
The incident took place in the town of Otukpo 
Police said the matter was being investigated Vanguard reported
Read the full reports here and here
Source BBC Monitoring on   Dec

NASHVILLE Tennessee  The man believed to be responsible for the Christmas Day bombing that tore through downtown Nashville blew himself up in the explosion and appears to have acted alone federal officials said Sunday                       Investigators used DNA and other evidence to link the man identified as Anthony Quinn Warner to the mysterious explosion but said they have not determined a motive Officials have received hundreds of tips and leads but have concluded that no one other than Warner is believed to have been involved in the early morning explosion that damaged dozens of buildings and injured three people                       Nashville is considered safe said Metro Nashville Police Chief John Drake There are no known threats against this city                       In publicly identifying the suspect and his fate officials disclosed a major breakthrough in their investigation even as they acknowledged the lingering mystery behind the explosion which took place on a holiday morning well before downtown streets were bustling with activity and was accompanied by a recorded announcement warning anyone nearby that a bomb would soon detonate                       Then for reasons that may never be known the audio switched to a recording of Petula Clarks  hit Downtown shortly before the blast                       Investigators have not uncovered a singular motive for the act nor was it revealed why Warner had selected the particular location for the bombing which damaged an ATT building and has continued to wreak havoc on cellphone service and police and hospital communications in several Southern states as the company worked to restore service                       Authorities said Warner  was not known to law enforcement before the Christmas blast                       Warner who public records show had experience with electronics and alarms and who had also worked as a computer consultant for a Nashville realtor had been regarded as a person of interest in the bombing since at least Saturday when federal and local investigators converged on a home in suburban Nashville linked to him                       Federal agents could be seen looking around the property searching the home and the backyard A Google Maps image captured in May  had shown a recreational vehicle similar to the one that exploded parked in the backyard but it was not at the property on Saturday according to an Associated Press reporter at the scene                       On Sunday morning police formally named Warner as being under investigation                       Officials said their identification of Warner relied on several key pieces of evidence including DNA found at the explosion site Investigators had previously revealed that human remains had been found in the vicinity                       In addition investigators from the Tennessee Highway Patrol recovered parts from the RV among the wreckage from the blast and were able to link the vehicle identification number to an RV that was registered to Warner officials said                       Were still following leads but right now there is no indication that any other persons were involved said Douglas Korneski special agent in charge of the FBIs Memphis field office Weve reviewed hours of security video surrounding the recreation vehicle We saw no other people involved

At least four killed many wounded in Afghanistan attacks At least four people have been killed in separate attacks across Afghanistan officials said on Monday raising further concerns about the fate of peace talks that have been suspended until at least next month No one claimed responsibility for the attacks but a local ISIL ISIS affiliate opposed to the peace process has continued to regularly target civilians and Afghan security forces The Taliban has halted its attacks on the United States and international forces but continue to target Afghan security forces even as the group held talks this year with the Washingtonbacked government The Taliban attacked a police district headquarters in the western Farah province early on Monday killing one policeman and wounding three others according to Mohibullah Mohib a spokesman for the provincial police chief He said the attack began when a suicide bomber was shot by police His vehicle exploded however and then gunmen opened fire He said at least four attackers were killed and eight others wounded In the eastern Ghazni province two employees of the provincial revenue agency were shot and killed according to Ahmad Khan Serat a spokesman for the provincial police chief In the eastern Khost province a roadside bomb killed a member of the security forces and wounded two other people including a provincial council member according to Kafel Rayan head of the provincial council In two explosions on Monday in the capital Kabul at least six people were wounded according to Kabul police One targeted employees of the National Statistics Authority who were in a minibus in the Guzargah neighbourhood The blast also wounded at least six people said Ferdaws Faramarz spokesman for the Kabul police chief He said the bomb had been placed on a bicycle Earlier on Monday a sticky bomb blew up a vehicle belonging to security forces in the Kolola Pushta area of the city but caused no casualties said Faramarz adding that investigations into both the bomb attacks had begun Security officials also said Kabul police defused two bombs that were placed near an orphanage and a residential house as explosions and targeted killings become a new normal in the capital in recent months Afghanistans Vice President Amrullah Saleh who took charges of Kabul security over two months ago said on Monday that the number of police forces in Kabul will be doubled Saleh said basic knowledge of detection and investigation will be the main criteria of the new recruitments

the internal fighting began to return to their houses in the southern regions He said that the displaced families returned after the fighting ended in their areas and the adjacent villages in Abyan        BELGRADE dpaAFX  North Macedonian police on Monday arrested eight people suspected of links with the Islamic State terrorist group the Interior Ministry in Skopje said  The eight were arrested in Skopje and Kumanovo following an investigation lasting several months the ministry added in a statement  The arrests come less than two months after a radicalized Islamist of Macedonian and Albanian origin carried out a deadly terrorist attack in Vienna  Raids in several locations in North Macedonia uncovered weapons ammunition and explosive devices for planned attacks seeking to create uncertainty and fear among citizens the ministry said  The plans shared by the group in an online chat were said to include blueprints for the manufacture of explosivelined vests for suicide bombings  One of the suspects had allegedly fought for Islamic State in Syria  North Macedonia has a large mostly Muslim ethnic Albanian community and radical Islamists have been active in the country as well as elsewhere in the region   North Macedonian police uncovered an alleged Islamic State cell in September The latest suspects allegedly have links to that first group  On November  an Austrianborn man of MacedonianAlbanian descent carried out a terrorist attack in Vienna killing four and wounding more than  people before being shot dead by police  After the attack Austria asked North Macedonian authorities to cooperate in the investigation as the killer held both Austrian and North Macedonian passports The Interior Ministry in Skopje immediately said it was responding to the request   Copyright dpa

McElfresh said the network restoration effort was even more difficult because it happened while maintaining the integrity of an active crime scene in cooperation with federal and local law enforcement
ATT said today that the majority of its network services have now been restored in Nashville The company sent  of its disaster recovery support trailers and deployed  temporary cell towers to help with the situation

most of them students  and injured dozens more according to official figures Unofficial government sources have put the death toll at  Reuters news agency has reported With lower than average attendance this week the otherwise lively campus saw grimfaced students walk briskly to classes crossing the additional security check posts erected after the attackAccording to a notification by the dormitories have been reopened and the students asked to returnExplaining the new security strategy for the university Interior Ministry spokesman Tariq Arian told University World News that the government had strengthened its operations and surveillance and would not allow academic institutions to be harmed in the raging war in the country A major part of it is to deal with the propaganda war by the Taliban but we will address potential loopholes in security without turning academic institutions into military positions he said Established in the s Kabul University with over  registered students is the countrys biggest staterun academic institution located in the heart of countrys capitalJournalism student Mareena Ahmed said on returning to campus There are additional check points security guards and more vigilant checking But this cannot bring back the precious lives we have lost to the terrorist attackWith some marks of the brazen attack now washed away and the shattered university building which had been damaged by grenades cleared for resumption of classes students and teachers laid floral wreaths at the site to pay homage to the victims Many stay awayBut others stayed away Dodging bullets and narrowly escaping death on  November Zainab Ahmadi  of the school of policy and public administration where most of the slain students were in classes said she is still in shock too fearful to return to the campus I cannot bear the sight of empty chairs where my friendly classmates would sit she told University World News I feel terrified even at the sight of the military uniforms and weapons and fear a repeat of the tragedySami Mahdi a broadcaster and lecturer at KU said via Twitter that the school of policy and public administration where he teaches lost  students aged between  and  and paid tribute to them They will be remembered forever he said The attack began in the morning of  November local time when at least three attackers equipped with assault rifles and hand grenades stormed the northern entrance of the countrys leading university spraying bullets at everyone in sight shocked officials and students told University World NewsResponsibility has been claimed by Daesh or Islamic State IS with the attackers identified by the IS propaganda website Amaq as Amas Panshiri and Tariq KhorasaniJust a week before the KU attack at least  teenage FBI Identifies Suspect Killed in Nashville Christmas Day Blast Motive Unclear CNSNewscom  The FBI on Sunday named the suspect behind the Christmas Day blast in downtown Nashville saying the dead man evidently acted alone with a motive yet to be determined Forensic tests on human remains at the explosion site confirmed him to be yearold Anthony Quinn Warner of Antioch Tennessee said special agent in charge Doug Korneski of the FBI Memphis Field Office FBI and ATF Bureau of Alcohol Tobacco Firearms and Explosives agents are continuing to recover and analyze evidence he said in a statement The motive for the incident is still unclear Leads are still being followed but at this time there is no indication that any other individuals are involved Based on the evidence weve gathered to this point weve come to the conclusion that an individual named Anthony Warner is the bomber US Attorney Don Cochran told a press conference That he was present when the bomb went off and that he perished in the bombing A recreational vehicle registered to Warner arrived in the area around  AM Central Time on Christmas morning and the explosion occurred at approximately  AM damaging dozens of businesses in the area The RVs vehicle identification number and tips from the public led investigators to Warners home in suburban Nashville which was searched by federal agents on Saturday The explosion occurred outside an ATT data transmission center which suffered significant damage It disrupted Internet and phone services including  lines across parts of Tennessee Kentucky and Alabama with some services still affected on Sunday What has made network restoration so difficult is doing it while maintaining the integrity of an active crime scene in cooperation with federal and local law enforcement ATT Communications CEO Jeff McElfresh said on Sunday afternoon Hundreds of employees  our own ATT employees as well as first responders  have stepped in over the last two days to restore service Weve restored power to multiple floors in the building and deployed over  temporary satellite cell towers and  additional trailers of disaster recovery equipment across the impacted area According to the Nashville Tennessean  recorded messages heard emanating from the RV before the blast included the sound of a digitized voice giving warnings to evacuate the area along with bursts of music identified as the  Petula Clark hit Downtown The Metropolitan Nashville Police Department said six of its officers had worked to evacuate people from apartments in the area and saved lives in the process Warner has been described as a selfemployed computer repairman A former FBI assistant director for counterintelligence Frank Figliuzzi told CBS News Face the Nation on Sunday that the perpetrator may have been motivated by conspiracy theories circulating online relating to the G technology network Youll find almost anything imaginable and unimaginable online and it may be that this is how  partially what drove this individual he said Figliuzzi said the incident was a wakeup call and a warning for all of us about how vulnerable our infrastructure is how relatively easy it is for a single individual to do this The FBIs Korneski asked anyone who knew Warner to come forward with information that may help authorities as they investigate possible motives for the explosion

highway linking major Syrian cities Late Sunday the Russian Defense Ministry said it had sent more military servicemen to the flash point Earlier during negotiations with the Turkish side agreements the situation it said Russia whose fighter jets patrol the area has urged both sides to deescalate The defense ministry said the Russian military had not detected shelling from Turkishbacked militants Challenging presidential and parliamentary elections were held on Sunday in the Central African Republic where for the last week a coalition of armed groups put pressure on the government in an effort to obstruct the vote Gunshots were heard in Bangui from Saturday night to Sunday morning according to RFIs service Afrique However this did not stop voters in the capital from gathering at polling stations in early morning Many voters said they came out to vote so they could say no to an armed takeover of power reported correspondent Charlotte Cosset and RFIs Florence Morice citing some problems with voting including late opening of polling stations a lack of electoral materials and issues with voter listsPolling difficultiesIt was difficult by Sunday evening to obtain a comprehensive and precise overview of areas where voting could not take place CARs National Authority in charge of Elections ANE said some  polling stations across the country could not open according to a preliminary assessment representing about  of the countrys  polling stations However an assessment by the official ballot security committee which was leaked at the end of Sunday painted a bleaker picture saying voting could not take place in around one third of subprefectures This was the case in Bouar some  kilometres northwest of Bangui where heavy gunfire from Sunday morning created panic amongst locals Neither polling station staff nor voters went to polling stations in this market town in western Central African Republic near the border with Cameroon It was a similar story in the town of Bossangoa some  kilometres north of the capital where electoral officials were threatened The town is considered a former stronghold of former President Francois Boziz In other areas only partial voting could take place In Bambari  kilometres northeast of Bangui it took the intervention of the UN mission in CAR MINUSCA before voting could start in certain polling stations on Sunday afternoon In the north of the CAR several motorbikes used to transport voting materials were targeted by armed groups and heavy gunfire was heard by local residents forcing people to stay away from polling stations In Kaga Bandoro  kilometres north of the capital only one polling station out of eight was operational People came to the central Kaga Bandoro polling station but the other polling stations could not vote said the town mayor Abel Cherif Polling stations were threatened by armed groups and people didnt go neither the polling station staff the voting materials or voters he added In the city of Carnot in the west of CAR polling officials and voters managed to proceed with election day under the protection of UN peacekeepers Nevertheless a raid by the Return Reclamation Rehabilitation R rebel group later in the day destroyed all their efforts when ballot boxes were burnt and administrative buildings were attackedElsewhere in the capital organisational problems impeded voting notably at the Koudoukou polling station in the PK neighbourhood The other day I came to collect my voter card but they didnt have it said voter Hawa Diarra who got up at am on Sunday to go and vote I was told that I could vote with the receipt but today Im told I cannot vote what do I do she told RFI at pm when she still had not cast her ballot Despite her receipt her name did not figure on the electoral roll And Hawa Diarra was not the only case like this at least ten voters at the Koudoukou polling station had the same difficulty Other problems included missing ballot papers with only the presidential ballot paper available and no voting materials for the parliamentary vote Rebels groups in the CAR had called on people not to vote and have seized several towns close to the capital Bangui Incumbent President FaustinArchange Touadra is bidding for a second term in office and had accused his predecessor Boziz of attempting to launch a coup with rebel groups Three UN peacekeepers were killed by unknown attackers in the runup to the vote CAR authorities had rejected demands by the opposition to delay the vote because of insecurity

Authorities identify Nashville RV bomber Friday a large recreational vehicle exploded in downtown Nashville damaging three city blocks Authorities say that Anthony Quinn Warner age  was responsible for the explosion and that Warner died in the explosion The blast which police have called an intentional act injured at least three people and destroyed  businesses and other buildings including an ATT building which knocked out phone service for days Early Friday the vehicle announced a warning for people to evacuate with a recording of a womans voice This gave the Nashville Police time to evacuate the area or there would have been considerable loss of life Authorities said that they dont believe theres a current threat to Nashville Federal agents searched Warners house on Saturday A Google street view showed an RV parked in the backyard matching the description of the one police said was used in the bombing Human tissue was found after the explosion with DNA said to be a match of Warner leading police to believe that Warner died in the blast After hearing the bomb notice the police officer on the scene went to check for tags but saw nothing to identify the recreational vehicle which had all its shades down to obstruct any view from the inside Authorities heeded the warning and gave the order to evacuate US Attorney for the Middle District of Tennessee Don Cochran said on Sunday in a press conference that Warner is the bomber and was present when the bomb went off Douglas Korneski the FBIs special agent in charge of the Memphis Field Office said that there is no indication that anyone else was involved in the explosion Hours of video surveillance footage are being reviewed by investigators Authorities said that this was used in making the determination that Warner was the lone individual involved in the bombing Korneski has called on anyone with information or who may have known Warner to contact authorities Investigators are looking at any and all possible motives Korneski said Warner had lived at a home in Antioch southeast of Nashville That address was searched by agents with the FBI and US Bureau of Alcohol Tobacco Firearms and Explosives Saturday following the Christmas Day blast Nashville Mayor John Cooper told CBS News Face the Nation that he believed there was a connection between the bombing and the ATT building nearby The blast took down ATT service in the region the company said Sunday that it is still working to restore it

attack was thwarted due to the timely action of security guards and police present at the scene who lost their lives otherwise it could have easily turned into a bloodbath had the attackers penetrated have crossed the border and carried out attacks on Pakistani soil as well A weak provincial government with limited funding and expertise to improve the civilian side of the security apparatus only adds to the problem Given the volatile security situation in Balochistan and the ability of terrorist outfits operating in the region aided by foreign powers to carry out violent attacks despite efforts to control it a revised strategy is required because clearly the present one is not working However the first step in this exercise would be for both the federal and provincial governments along with relevant security and intelligence agencies to recognize that there is a problem only then can a solution be devised and implemented

Islamic State group IS has claimed to have captured two Christians and burnt six churches in an attack on four villages in northeast Nigeria on  December
In a statement published on  December IS said its militants attacked the villages of DebiroHawul Shaffa and Tashan Alade in Borno state where they clashed with the police allegedly killing one officer and four members of a propolice militia
In the same post the group claimed that the number of casualties was six 
The group said its militants also torched houses belonging to Christians in the villages They also allegedly seized a x vehicle and weapons and ammunition before withdrawing
The group later released images that purportedly showed the aftermath of the attacks on the villages
Attacks on Christians in Nigeria have increased during the holiday season 
The latest alleged attack comes after IS claimed responsibility for a deadly attack on a Christian village in the northeastern Nigerian state of Adamawa on  December
Also on  December militants of rival group Boko Haram raided the mostly Christian village of Pemi in Borno state where they burnt down a church and killed at least  people
On  December IS claimed it captured a Christian man in Borno state
On  December the group claimed to have captured three Christian civilians and a soldier in a fake checkpoint in Borno state
IS operates in West Africa under the banner of its West Africa Province ISWAP but it is mainly active in Nigeria
The jihadist group has repeatedly made its animosity towards Christians clear spelling it out through messages and attacks For more information see Islamic States position on Christians
The latest IS claim was released via the groups channel on the decentralised platform RocketChat

By BBC Monitoring
A shadowy militant group in Iraq has claimed an attack that targeted a logistics convoy belonging to the USled international coalition against the Islamic State group
Martyr Karim Daraam Brigade claimed the attack which took place in Diwaniya Province south of Baghdad in a statement circulated on social media on  December
The group vowed more attacks on the US interests in Iraq according to the statement
On  December an explosive device went off on AlSamawa highway targeting a logistics convoy affiliated to the international coalition The blast injured a driver and damaged three vehicles in the convoy
New shadowy militant Shia groups have emerged in Iraq over recent months Their operations and activities including rocket attacks appeared to have one mission in common  threatening the US forces stationed in Iraq and calling for their expulsion
Explainer Iraqi shadow militias  new Iranian strategy against US
USled coalition convoys are frequently attacked with explosive devices in Iraq
The blast comes ahead of the  January anniversary of the killing of Iranian general Qasem Soleimani and Iraqi militia leader Abu Mahdi alMuhandis
The coalition often blames Iranbacked militias many of which form part of the paramilitary Popular Mobilisation Forces for such attacks
Hostilities between Iran and the US have recently surged again after they reached a peak in January when a US air strike killed Soleimani and Muhandis near Baghdad International Airport

The following is compiled from a selection of reports and headlines in lunchtime bulletins newspapers websites and news agencies on  December 
IntraAfghan peace talks
Some Afghan newspapers have discussed the upcoming round of intraAfghan peace talks in their editorials today
The peace talks will resume on  January in Doha and will be held between the Talibans and Afghan governments peace negotiating teams
The High Council for National Reconciliation HCNR  Afghanistans authority on the peace process  has confirmed that the upcoming round of peace talks will be held in Qatari capital Doha after President Ghani agreed for the same
The independent Hashte Sobh newspaper said in an editorial that the second round is already deadlocked even before it could begin
The Afghan negotiators says ceasefire would be first thing to discuss in the second round of peace talks while the Taliban say ceasefire would be the last issue put forward with the governments delegation on the negotiating table it said
Moreover an editorial in the private Etilaate Roz has supported First VicePresident Amrullah Salehs remarks who recently expressed concern over Taliban leader Mullah Baradars meeting with militants in Pakistan
The first vicepresidents remarks about the Taliban are true because the Taliban have gained confidence But this part of Mr Amrullah Salehs statement that the Talibans confidence is empty does not seem very accurate Taliban are a political and military reality today The world has recognised this fact and that is why it is sitting at the negotiating table with the Taliban The next round of intraAfghan talks is politically and tactically complex and the need for unanimity in Afghanistan is undeniable the editorial said
Taliban attacks in the south
The private Channel One TV TV has reported that around  security checkpoints have been captured by the Taliban in Kandahar province
The channel has said that a senate delegation has confirmed that security forces have evacuated  checkpoints in Panjwai Zherai and Arghandab districts of the province
The channel also cited a source as saying that forces have retreated from  checkpoints
The Defence Ministry however has rejected the reports and its spokesman Fawad Aman said that many Taliban militants have been killed in the province in clashes
Their Talibans key members have been killed and their strong positions have been destroyed The Afghan security and defence forces have been making advances in the mentioned districts The security situation is improving there with each passing day he said
Meanwhile TV also reported that the Taliban have captured most districts of Zabul province
Citing Zabul provincial council head Atta Jan Haqbin the channel reported that the provinces capital Qalat city was captured by the Taliban
He said that the province will fall to the Taliban if the government does not adopt required measures
Senators arrested over alleged bribery
Ariana News have reported that three Afghan senators have been arrested in Balkh province for allegedly taking bribes
According to Afghan spy body NDS and Attorney Generals Office AGO the senators had allegedly accepted a  bribe
NDS and AGO have said that further probe is being conducted for the matter
Balkh Governor Mohammad Farhad Azimi said during a press conference today that the senators had been sent to the province to inspect revenue offices
Increasing attacks in Kabul
At least  people have been killed and  others wounded in security incidents in less than  days in the Afghan capital of Kabul Tolo News has reported on its website
According to figures cited by the channel  security incidents have taken place in Kabul in the same period
Expressing concern over the increasing violence in the Afghan capital the private Maseer daily said in an editorial today that Kabul is more insecure than before
The militants are roaming the city with weapons and attack their targets but the government expects that no one should criticise or question them The government in consultation with competent people should find a way to fundamentally put an end to insecurity and targeted attacks in Kabul the editorial said
Security incidents
An explosion in Kabul injured two people today Tolo News reported in their afternoon bulletin
Citing eyewitnesses and Kabul Police headquarters the channel reported that a Defence Ministry vehicle was targeted by a mine blast at  local time  gmt
Separately two people were killed in an armed attack in Ghazni city today Tolo News Ariana News and TV reported today
Moreover Tolo News also reported that the Taliban carried out a bomb attack in Farah provinces Anar Dara district
According to Farah Governor Taj Mohammad Jahid a security official was killed in the attack and a number of Taliban militants were killed in clashes
Local officials have said that Afghan forces have thwarted attacks by the Taliban in Anar Dara
Furthermore Ariana News reported that  alQaeda militants were killed in air strikes by the Afghan forces in Helmand province
Citing Defence Ministry spokesman Fawad Aman the channel reported that a majority of the militants killed in the air strikes were foreign nationals
Source BBC Monitoring in Dari and Pashto  Dec

Opposition reiterates demand for Pakistan PMs resignation
The Pakistan Democratic Movement PDM an alliance of major opposition parties demanded on  December that Prime Minister Imran Khan step down The remarks were made at an event in the Larkana city to mark the th death anniversary of former prime minister and Pakistan Peoples Party PPP leader Benazir Bhutto The PDM which is leading a series of antigovernment rallies has called for Khans resignation fresh elections and an end to the militarys interference in politics
Liberal Englishlanguage newspaper Pakistan Today reported PPP cochairman Bilawal BhuttoZardari had stated that the PDM was here to rescue the country and to end the business of selected and selection referring to the allegation that the incumbent government was brought to power by the military establishment While paying tribute to his mother Benazir he said Benazir is alive today in the hearts of everyone and those who clashed with her their names are forgotten He went on to reiterate that if Imran Khan refused to resign by  January the opposition would stage a march to Islamabad Addressing the rally via videolink the PPP cochairman Asif Ali Zardari said the Pakistan TehreekeInsaf PTI government would collapse under its own weight and predicted the ruling political party would perish just like the parties formed by the military dictators in the past He also challenged the government to hold elections and see the people stood with whom

bug give a hug Spread the flu to every Jew Another antiSemitic post was a fake Centers for Disease Control and Prevention warning urging those with COVID to visit a local synagogue or mosque to spread the virus According to the SWC antiSemites have a historic pattern of blaming Jews for outbreaks of disease AntiSemites have blamed Jews for the medieval Black Plague to the WWI Spanish Flu the SWC become a hotbed for antiSemitic conspiracy theories The social media platform Telegram ranked second on the list as neoNazis white supremacists and others have turned to the site with little or no rules on content moderation amid other platforms such as Facebook increasing restrictions against hate groups the SWC said Third on the list was Nation of Islam leader Louis Farrakhan  who according to the SWC has continued a yearlong hate campaign and alleged at one point Jews tried to kill him with radiated seeds In fourth place were attacks against Jews by farleft and farright extremists in eliminate Jews during the Holocaust Khamenei told Times of Israel he was seeking Israels destruction but not elimination of all Jews in response to US leaders accusing him of encouraging genocide The truck bomb that exploded in the early hours of Christmas Day in Nashville Tennessee seemed almost designed not to kill people  only three were injured A minute warning even emanated from the RV recreational vehicle that it was about to explode giving police time to evacuate residents in the area What it might have been targeting was infrastructure The bomb went off next to an ATT telecommunications facility The shock reached far beyond the city and even the state cellphone Internet and WiFi services were disrupted over a wide area According to the Associated Press emergency systems in Alabama and Kentucky were also affected The domino effect disrupted air traffic control as well grounding flights at Nashvilles airport Security experts noted that the bombing which appears to have been an elaborate suicide was a wakeup call about the vulnerability of critical infrastructure The incident also came at a time of exceptional fragility with the country deeply divided and still navigating a contested political transition On Sunday the Federal Bureau of Investigation FBI and police confirmed that the perpetrator  yearold longtime Nashville resident Anthony Quinn Warner  was in the RV when it exploded The focus is now on the dead mans motivation for the method timing and location Terrorism expert and professor of communication and Middle East studies at Georgia State University Mia Bloom cautioned in a series of tweets against rushing to label Warner as a terrorist or suicide bomber Suicide bombing requires some political motive to send a message she wrote There are several preattack indicators of which clearing his debts paying off bills signing away the deed to his homes are consistent with someone who assumes they will die For me the question is where did he get the explosive If hes a lone actor who did he tell Dr Colin P Clarke senior research fellow at The Soufan Centre a global security consultancy told The Straits Times It all comes down to motive If this was just suicide then its not terrorism But if the intent was to send a message political or ideological then it is Warners motive may have had something to do with where he parked the RV As Mr John Cooper mayor of Nashville told CBS on Sunday To all of us locally it feels like there has to be some connection with the ATT facility and the site of the bombing Thats just local insight because its got to have something to do with the infrastructure According to some reports Warner an electronics expert lived a lowkey life with no visible signs of political beliefs Investigators are trying to find out if he bought into conspiracy theories about G technology  that it spreads the coronavirus suppresses the immune system or is being used to spy on Americans Cellphone towers in England and New Zealand have been damaged on the basis of these theories At least eight cellphone towers in Tennessee have been vandalised since December last year the Chattanooga Times Free Press reported last month It is suspected that G conspiracy theories may have played a role said Tennessee Department of Safety and Homeland Security spokesman Wes Mosley Mr Frank Figliuzzi a former assistant FBI director told CBS Face The Nation on Sunday that Warners act is a warning about how vulnerable the nations infrastructure is such that it was relatively easy for a single individual to cause such extensive damage Weve concentrated post on getting our hands around all the chemical companies mass orders of precursors for known explosives and look what an individual can do on his or her own when they simply amass quantities of things that are under the radar screen he said

Law enforcement continues to make progress in the investigation ATT is restoring service and some cleanup downtown started Monday But a mountain of work lays ahead Residents and businesses affected by the blast have to piece together the parts of their lives and livelihoods shattered on Christmas morning While federal state and local authorities identified who is responsible  they are still digging deeper into what happened and why  David Rausch the director of the Tennessee Bureau of Investigation said the best way to determine motive is to talk to the person responsible  but that is not possible  Tips DNA analysis and the vehicle identification number tied to the exploded recreational vehicle led authorities to a yearold Nashville man Anthony Q Warner  Authorities determined Warner was the lone bomber and died in the blast      A lot of it will be what we can gather through interviews and ultimately what the evidence will point us toward Rausch said in a Monday interview on the Today show We may never find out the exact reasoning behind the activity that took place Nashville bomber ID Anthony Quinn Warner selfemployed computer guru IDd as lone Nashville bomber killed in blast Investigation Tips DNA and vehicle identification number led law enforcement to ID of Christmas bomber The FBIs behavioral analysis unit is helping to figure out what kind of person would set off a bomb in downtown Nashville Doug Korneski special agent in charge for the FBIs Memphis field office said at a Saturday news conference  It is likely Warner did not intend to kill anyone Rausch said A recorded warning and minute countdown was heard coming from the RV giving people time to evacuate before the bomb exploded early Christmas morning on a street with little activity  It does appear that the intent was more destruction than death Rausch said Thats all still speculation at this point as we continue in our investigation with all of our partners Only Warner died in the blast but it injured three people and damaged at least  buildings including the nearby ATT facility Several hours after the explosion the company reported widespread outages that have lasted days raising questions about vulnerabilities in the countrys communications infrastructure  On Monday morning ATT announced the majority of service has been restored in Nashville Restoration work was expected to continue throughout the day  Our mobility network is now operating normally nearly all home internet and video customers have been restored and our business customers are coming back online the Monday ATT statement said   The communications company is relying on portable cell sites to keep some of its service going ATT was expected to set up about  portable cell sites to serve as a temporary network in a parking lot at Nissan Stadium on Sunday according to the Titans We have begun to turn down portable sites that are no longer needed given the recovery of service but we will have resources standing by in the region as needed ATT said on Monday  The building damaged in the blast is receiving adequate power to most of its floors but ATT teams continue to keep an eye on the temperatures in the building to keep equipment running   The full extent of the damage caused by the blast to downtown buildings is unclear Mayor John Cooper initially estimated  buildings were damaged by the blast but no list was available late Monday morning  Inspectors from the Metro Nashville Codes Department have been unable to assess the condition of any of the buildings within the perimeter of the federal investigation which is blocked off to the public In a Sunday news conference Nashville Fire Chief William Swann said as portions of the blast site are released by law enforcement they will be cleared by relevant city departments before being turned over to those who owned and occupied them  But some cleanup started Monday morning A group of Nashville Downtown heard as they swept up the pieces and threw them away  a small piece of the city restored  Natalie Allison Yihyun Jeong and Cassandra Stephenson contributed to this report  Reach Holly Meyer at evidence charge There was also reportedly a child in the vehicle when it was finally intercepted by police Turgeon was arrested after the truck shut down Highway  South in Lebanon near Cedars of Violence Increases In Final Stretch Of US Withdrawal From Afghanistan With the United States forces in full retreat from the country and the peace talks between the Taliban and the government on hold until January violence monopolizes the daytoday in Afghanistan Terror broke out this time in the form of sticky bombs and there were two attacks in Kabul and Ferozkoh Ghor province to hit highranking officials In the center of the capital the citys deputy governor Mahboobullah Mohebi was killed and one of his aides and two other people were injured The attack in Ghor killed the number two of the Provincial Council Abdurahman Atshan No group claimed responsibility for these actions aimed at weakening the power of the institutions On paper Kabul should be the safest square in Afghanistan but in just over a month the center of the capital has been the target of two indiscriminate rocket and mortar attacks and the university campus was the scene of a jihad operation urban area in which  students died In this case it was the jihadist group Islamic State IS who claimed responsibility for the massacre but the Government did not believe this version and accused the Taliban of being the true authors of the assault Journalists are also in the spotlight and two wellknown presenters have died in the last three weeks The peace talks are on hold until January and the president Ashraf Ghani  asked the two sides to consider the possibility of abandoning the luxurious hotels of Doha to continue the dialogue in Afghanistan The city of Kandahar a stronghold of the insurgency in the south of the country offered to resume the dialogue between Afghans during the next month The Taliban have respected the ceasefire agreed with the United States since February  in exchange for the withdrawal of its troops but they refuse to accept a truce with the government and this complicates talks that are progressing very slowly In these months operations against the Afghan security forces have intensified and the clashes leave a high number of casualties among civilians soldiers police and Taliban The initial hope sparked by the talks has been faded by the violence Finally the United States troops will not be out of the country for Christmas as Trump hinted in October in a message in a clear electoral tone but their withdrawal is progressing according to the deadlines agreed with the insurgency In an interview with the BBC network the Taliban leaders reminded the next tenant of the White House Joe Biden  the importance of respecting the agreement The Islamist group believes that each foreign soldier who remains in the country beyond the stipulated time will be considered a legitimate target and we will resume the holy war

The Yemeni government will reportedly be returning to the interim capital Aden on  December after its ministers took oath in the Saudi capital Riyadh
In a breaking news report on its website on  December privatelyowned Aden alGhad news website quoted a government source as saying that all members of the newly formed cabinet would be arriving in Aden from Riyadh the following day
It added that the ministers would be based at the Maashiq presidential palace in the southern port city
Senior member of the Nasserist party Hussein Abdulrahman alAghbari who has been named as the new minister of local administration refused to attend the swearingin ceremony in Riyadh Local media reported that he believed that it should take place in the interim capital Aden in accordance with the agreement between the government and the STC
The new cabinet lineup was announced earlier this month as part of a Saudibrokered peace agreement between the internationallyrecognised government and the UAEbacked separatist Southern Transitional Council STC which was signed over a year ago
The government left Aden after the STC seized control of the city amid deadly clashes in the summer of 
Military reinforcements sent to Aden presidential palace
On the evening of  December large scale military reinforcements belonging to the Saudiled military coalition were said to have arrived in the southern province of Abyan on their way to Aden Local sources told privatelyowned AlMasdar Online news website that lorries carrying tanks and armoured vehicles along with ambulances had stopped in the town of Shoqra en route to Aden
 A government military source told AlMasdar that the reinforcements would be deployed in the area around the presidential palace They would support the Saudi and progovernment Presidential Protection forces which will later be based there in order to provide security for the government members who would be arriving in the coming days said the source
Addressing the cabinet following the swearing in ceremony on  December Yemeni President Abdrabbuh Mansour Hadi said that saving the wartorn countrys struggling economy would be the top priority for the government
Hadi has been based in Riyadh since  having fled house arrest in the Yemeni capital Sanaa following the takeover of the city by the Houthis The Saudiled coalition launched a campaign of aerial bombardment aimed at defeating the rebel movement shortly after Hadi left
Source BBC Monitoring in Arabic  gmt  Dec

Islamic State group IS has released photos and a video to claim attacks on two army barracks in the eastern DR Congo province of North Kivu
In a series of images released on  December IS said its militants burnt down a barracks in Ruwenzori in the Beni region 
The IS photos showed bodies and claimed the militants seized weapons and ammunitions in the attack
The group did not specify when the attack took place 
In a separate video issued on the same day IS claimed its militants raided a second barracks in Losilosi village in Beni on  December 
The minute footage shows militants roaming a makeshift camp as structures burn in the background
A speaker out of vision claims they had set the camp on fire after soldiers had ran away He appears to be speaking in a local language but Arabic subtitles are provided
Earlier on  December the group claimed killing four soldiers and injuring another in the attacks
The Beni region where the IS affiliate is most active is home to several rebel groups including the Allied Democratic Forces  ADF
The latest IS photos and video were issued in the name of the groups socalled Central Africa Province which is also active in Mozambique
They were released via ISs channels on the decentralised platform RocketChat
Source RocketChat messaging service in Arabic  gmt  Dec

Stories being covered today by BBC Monitoring from Ukrainian broadcast press and social media sources
Coronavirus
To read the best of our Covid coverage click here To set up thematic feeds of our content on the pandemic please see here for details
Optimistic Covid figures
Major Ukrainian TV channels had differing takes on the recent reduction of new Covid cases in Ukraine Some expressed scepticism over the official statistics
Epidemic figures are too reassuring even for a Monday was how pipe tycoon Viktor Pinchuks ICTV commented on the  new Covid cases reported on  December The figures that should give joy raise red flags for some reason since there are no serious grounds for the disease to retreat as hospitals are crowded the channel said
Speaking in the studio Ukraines chief sanitary doctor Viktor Lyashko denied that the lower figures were due to fewer tests being carried out He said that the Covid situation has stabilised
Tycoon Ihor Kolomoyskyys One Plus One TV channel wondered why record low figures did not prompt the authorities to cancel the lockdown planned for January It stressed that three times fewer tests than usual were carried out over the past day
However the proopposition Inter TV channel quoted Kyiv doctors as saying over the phone that the situation with Covid hospitalisations was improving and that hospitals now were receiving fewer patients consistent with officials statistics
US aid for Ukrainian army
The US government has handed to the Ukrainian Armed Forces equipment for Covid tests the Censornet website reported The Medical Command of the Ukrainian Armed Forces said that the US Defence Threat Reduction Agency has supplied PCR kits as the epidemiological situation in Ukraine is deteriorating
OTHER STORIES
Constitutional Court controversy
The Constitutional Court said on Facebook that the any attempts to suspend its head Oleksandr Tupytskyy will run counter to the constitution The court commented on media reports about the ProsecutorGenerals Office asking President Volodymyr Zelensky to suspend Tupytskyy for two months while he is investigated for alleged bribery The courts statement listed all the possible reasons for dismissing Constitutional Court judges and said that no government agency or state official can dismiss or suspend any Constitutional Court judge unless a majority of judges vote to this effect
Zelensky has repeatedly said that Tupytskyy should go after the court found unconstitutional a number of legal provisions a ruling that domestic and foreign experts believe puts Ukraines anticorruption efforts at risk
Russias subversive operations
The Russian secret services continue attempts to destabilise the situation in Ukraine and discredit senior officers from the Ukrainian Defence Ministrys Main Intelligence Directorate the Pryamyy TV channel close to former President Petro Poroshenko said The directorate says it has intercepted a conversation between Russian FSB operatives based in Simferopol Crimea and Donetsk regarding the directorates chief Kyrylo Budanov The FSB operatives reportedly discussed transferring a media operation against Budanov to the FSB department for special operations and sabotage Pryamyy added that the operation would involve former officers of the Ukrainian Security Service who defected to the FSB after the annexation of Crimea
Presidents party losing support
The recent opinion poll conducted by two reputable pollsters Democratic Initiatives foundation and the Kyiv Sociology Institute has put the proRussian Opposition Platform for Life in the lead with  per cent followed by Zelenskys Servant of the People with  per cent and Poroshenkos European Solidarity with  per cent The margin of error was within  per cent the Ukrayinska Pravda website reported Zelensky political party has been overtaken in opinion polls by the opposition for the first time since Zelensky came to power
Gas price audit
Prime Minister Denys Shmyhal has tasked acting energy minister Yuriy Vitrenko with checking the fairness of gas prices Ukrayinska Pravda reported Shmyhal noted that the national gas company Naftohaz Ukrayiny offers the lowest price while private regional gas distribution companies charge more We should take an audit of tariffs to lower their components which are not fair or justified when it comes to the market situation You have all levers to settle these issues Shmyhal told Vitrenko
Donbas security
Sending international peacekeepers to Donbas is being considered as an option for implementing the Minsk accords the Ukrainian deputy prime minister for reintegration of temporarily occupied territories Oleksiy Reznikov told the One Plus One TV channel  He said that a mandate for the peacekeeping mission would have to be supported by all parties to the talks as the Minsk accords provide only for OSCE monitoring without any peacekeeping component Peacekeepers are one of the solutions considered among other things within the basic model of the Minsk accords Reznikov said
ProRussian rebels in Donbas opened fire  times on  December wounding a Ukrainian soldier the government Joint Force Operation HQ said on Facebook The rebels used mm mm mortars grenade launchers small arms and drones the Ukrainian HQ reported
Social buzz
Many Ukrainian Facebook users were outraged by the exorbitant prices being charged at Bukovel Ukraines largest ski resort owned by tycoon Igor Kolomoyskyy
Look at this years prices at Bukovel What about a portion of sauerkraut for  hryvnyas  dollars at a local eatery popular Transcarpathian Region daily Mukachevonet said in a Facebook post The post had hundreds of comments and over  shares as Bukovel is a popular ski destination for many Ukrainians in the Christmas period
They are crazy This sauerkraut should cost some  hryvnyas a user commented
Prices like in London another user opined
I would rather go to Courchevel another user joked
Many Facebook users saw politics behind the heavy price tags in Bukovel eateries
This is a special treat cooked by chef Kolomoyskyy a user said
Is this the end to the epoch of poverty Zelenskys campaign slogan Holoborodko Zelenskys comedy character can you play it again another commentator said
Kolomoyskyys puppet was running for president promising Bukovelstyle life across Ukraine And now they are telling us on One Plus One TV how to make your salads cheaper or cook borsch without meat another user said
Source BBC Monitoring  Dec
